authority.title: Inethiwekhi Yeligunya
authority.subtitle: Inethiwekhi lesekelwe ekuvunyelweni lapho emabhizinisi lafanele akhomba khona lelinye kwelinye ngemvelo
authority.explainer: Zibhalise bese i-AI ikuhlanganisa nemabhizinisi lafanele, langancintisani nawe kuze lokubhaliwe kwakho kuzuze emalinki emvelo, emhleli — bese wena ubuyisela ilinki lapho ngempela kusita bafundzi bakho. Uhlala ulawula ngalokugcwele kutsi ngubani lolinka nawe nekutsi bangaki.
authority.no_websites: Ngena i-website kucala kuze ujoyine inethiwekhi.
authority.join_body: Khulisa ligunya lakho ngemalinki emhleli lafanele nalamanye emabhizinisi latsembekile. Ulawula ibhajethi yakho yemalinki, emakhasi labaluleke kakhulu nemikhakha lokufanele uyibalekele. Joyina, misa noma phuma noma ngasiphi sikhatsi.
authority.leave_confirm: Uphuma Enethiwekhini Yeligunya? Emalinki akho ngeke asafakwa noma emukelwe.
authority.no_pages: Akukho emakhasi labaluleke kakhulu okwanyalo. Ngeta emakhasi lofuna emalinki kuwo kakhulu.
authority.no_matches: Akukho lokuhlanganisiwe okwanyalo — cedzela iphrofayela yakho bese uphindze uhlole nakujoyina lamanye emabhizinisi.
authority.paused_note: Chubeka nebulunga bakho kuze ubone bemlingani labahlanganisiwe.
authority.no_links: Akukho malinki lasafakiwe. Emalinki engetwa ngekutentakalela nawukhicita lokucuketfwe.
authority.credits_note: Ema-backlink laphilako laletsiwe kucatsaniswa nenani lakho lwenyanga. Ema-link lalindzelwe asafakwa kuyo yonkhe inethiwekhi.

social.title: Kusabalalisa Kwezenhlalo
social.subtitle: Hlanganisa tinkhundla takho, khetsa kutsi tindzaba letishicilelwe timenyetelwa kuphi, bese ubona sonkhe simemetelo lesitsindziwe

social.token_hint: Ithokheni ye-API yekungena yale akhawunti (igcinwa ibhalwe ngemakhodi)

social.prefer_oneclick: Leli-platform lisekela kuxhumana ngekucindzetela kanye — kunconyiwe kubasebentisi labanyenti.
social.account_name_hint: Nome ngabe ngumaphi umaka wekubona le-akhawunti, e.g. "Mkhaya Facebook Page"

guides.facebook:
1. Yana ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Meta Business / Developers.
2. Yakha i-Page Access Token nemvume ye-pages_manage_posts.
3. Kopisha i-Page ID yakho (kuku-About/Settings yeliKhasi) kanye ne-token ngentansi.
guides.x:
1. Yana ku-developer.x.com bese uvula i-app yakho.
2. Khicita i-OAuth 2.0 user access token nesikhundla se-tweet.write.
3. Namatsisela i-token ngentansi.
guides.linkedin:
1. Yana ku-linkedin.com/developers bese uvula i-app yakho.
2. Tfola i-access token nesikhundla se-w_member_social.
3. Namatsisela i-author URN yakho (urn:li:person:XXXX) kanye ne-token ngentansi.
guides.instagram:
1. I-Instagram yakho kufanele ibe yi-Business account lexhunywe ku-Facebook Page.
2. Tfola i-token nemvume ye-instagram_content_publish.
3. Namatsisela i-Instagram user ID yakho kanye ne-token ngentansi.
guides.whatsapp:
1. Setela i-WhatsApp Cloud API ku-Meta.
2. Kopisha i-access token yakho lesimile.
3. Namatsisela inombolo yelucingo lemukeli (nekhodi yelive) kanye ne-token ngentansi.

ext_hint.instagram: I-Instagram Business account user ID yakho
ext_hint.whatsapp: Inombolo yelucingo lemukeli nekhodi yelive, e.g. 27821234567

Facebook: Products → Facebook Login → Settings → Valid OAuth Redirect URIs

Kufanele afane ngaluhlamvu ngaluhlamvu — ngaphandle kwemugca wekugcina, ngaphandle kwe-www.

skills_levy.what_this_is: Umholo ukhokha intsetselo yekutsutsukisa emakhono inyanga tonkhe nge-EMP201. Incenye yinye kuletisihlanu yayo ingabuyiselwa njengesibonelelo lesiphoceleleko, kodwa kuphela ngumcashi lohambisa Luhlelo Lwemakhono Emsebentini ngaphambi kwa-30 Mabasa.

councils.description: Tintsetselo temkhandlu, emazinga labalwa ngawo, nekutsi tiphetse baphi basebenti.

councils.no_beneficiary: Akukho sikhwama lesixhunyiwe, ngako intsetselo idonswa kodwa akukho lutho loluhlela kuyikhokha.

councils.ceiling_hint: Imikhandlu ibeka umkhawulo etintsetselweni teliphesenti. Ngaphandle kwawo loholela kakhulu udonselwa ngetulu inyanga tonkhe.
councils.source_hint: Lapho linani livela khona, sib. satiso sikagazethi semkhandlu
councils.members_help: Kuphela basebenti lo mkhandlu labaphetse. Kungeta wonkhe umuntu akulungile njengekunganjeti muntu.

report_sources.projects: Kusuka kumaphrojekthi imbala — Emaphrojekthi, bese uvula lelinye.
report_sources.work: Kusuka ekhasini leMsebenti lephrojekthi ngayinye, lapho sakhiwo nemisebenti yaso kwakhiwa khona.
report_sources.dependencies: Kusuka ku-Msebenti → Xhumanisa imisebenti, lapho umsebenti munye wentiwa ulindze lomunye.
report_sources.schedule: Kubalwa sihleli kusuka ebudzeni bemisebenti nekuxhumana kwayo. Kusebentise ekhasini leShejuli lephrojekthi.
report_sources.baseline: Kucatsanisa lamuhla nemugca losisekelo logciniwe. Gcina lomunye ekhasini leShejuli lephrojekthi.
report_sources.recurrence: Kusuka emtsetfweni wekuphindzaphindza ngekhatsi kwemsebenti, ekhasini leMsebenti.
report_sources.evidence: Kusuka kurejista yebufakazi — luhlelo lwasensimini, batfumeli bemamojula ne-API yekungenisa.
report_sources.figures: Kususelwa kubufakazi. Buka likhasi leTibalo lephrojekthi kuze utfole imitsetfo lengemuva kwelinani ngalinye.
report_sources.timesheets: Kusuka ku-Kuletfwa → Sikhatsi kuphrojekthi. Yengeta bantfu kucala kuthebhu yeBantfu — emahora abhaliswa ngelilunga.
report_sources.assignments: Kusuka ku-Msebenti, ngekwabela lilunga umsebenti, ngephesenti yekwabiwa. Yengeta bantfu kucala ku-Kuletfwa → Bantfu.
report_sources.labour: Emahora lavunyiwe × silinganiso. Beka silinganiso nawubhalisa emahora ku-Kuletfwa → Sikhatsi; kubalwa emahora lavunyiwe kuphela.
report_sources.costs: Kusuka ku-Kuletfwa → Tindleko kuphrojekthi, lapho kubhalwa khona tintfo, imishini nebacashi labangaphansi. Kubalwa kuphela lokuvunyiwe nalokukhokhiwe.
report_sources.approvals: Kudalwa ngekutitentakalela nangabe emahora nome tindleko kutfunyelwa. Kutsi ngubani loncumako kubekwa ku-Kuhlela → Indlela yekuvuma.
report_sources.links: Kusuka ekhasini lephrojekthi, ngekuxhuma lirekhodi kulomunye mojula — impahla, i-oda lekutsenga, inkontileka.
report_sources.registers: Kubhalwe eluhlwini lwemsebenti lwebuningozi, tinkinga netinguculo

registers.title: Buningozi, tinkinga netinguculo
registers.subtitle: Loko lokungahamba kabi, loko lokusevele kwahamba kabi, naloko lokuceliwe kutsi kuguculwe.
registers.risks_sub: Loko lokungakenteki — naloko lesihlose kukwenta ngako
registers.changes_sub: Ticelo tekugucula lisiseko, nemtsteleka wato lobhalwe ngembi kwesincumo
registers.change_sub: Bhala umtselela ngembi kwesincumo — ngiko lokwenta sincumo sibe nemcondvo.
registers.no_risks_hint: Umsebenti longenabo buningozi lobubhaliwe akusiwo umsebenti longenabo buningozi.
registers.no_changes_hint: Kugucula luhlelo ngaphandle kwalo akushiyi lutfo lokungacatsaniswa nalo umehluko.
registers.strategy_hint: Kubalekela kususa imbangela; kudlulisela kudlulisela kulomunye, kakhulu ngenkontileki nome nge-inshorensi.

registers.mitigation_hint: Sinyatselo lesitsatfwa nyalo kuze bungenteki kalula nome bungabi bubi kangaka.
registers.contingency_hint: Luhlelo lophindzela kulo. Kulubhala nyalo kubita kancane kunekulubhala ngaleso sikhatsi.
registers.closure_hint: Bwendlulile, bulawuliwe, nome bwemukelwe — sho kutsi ngubuphi.
registers.root_cause_required: Lesi sehlakalo nome inkinga lebalulekile, ngako imbangela yesisekelo kufanele ibhalwe ngembi kwekutsi ivalwe.

registers.impact_days_hint: Inombolo lengaphansi kweliciko yenta lusuku lusondzele.
registers.realise_note: Buningozi buhlala eluhlwini njengaloko lokwentekile, kantsi inkinga lensha ikhomba emuva kubo — lokuhlangana kubufakazi bekutsi bekunemuntfu labekubona kuta.
registers.confirm_submit_body: {code} iya kubo bonkhe labavuma tinguculo kulomsebenti. Ngeke ukwati kuyigucula nayisabuketwa.
registers.confirm_implement_body: {code} iyasetjentiswa futsi kutsatfwe lisiseko, kuze umtselela wayo esikhatsini ukwatiswe emuva kwaloko.
registers.needs_root_cause: Sehlakalo nome inkinga lebalulekile kufanele ibhale imbangela yayo yesisekelo.
registers.no_flow_auto: Ayikho indlela yekuvunywa lebekelwe ticelo tenguculo kulendzawo yemsebenti, ngako ibhalwe njengalevunyiwe.

templates.capture_note: Emalanga agcinwa njengetikhala kusuka ekucaleni kwemsebenti, hhayi njengemalanga ekhalendra — lithempulethi lelinemalanga langempela liliciniso ngelusuku lelibhalwe ngalo bese liyaphambana onkhe lamanye emalanga lalandzelako.
templates.none_hint: Tsatsa umsebenti lohambe kahle, bese lolandzelako ucala kuwo.
templates.sub_type_hint: Tindlu, imigwaco, i-ERP, umkhankhaso — nome ngabe bantfu bakubita njani.
templates.confirm_remove_body: {name} ngeke lisanikwa. Imisebenti leyentiwe ngalo ayitseleleki.
templates.confirm_hide_body: {name} lithempulethi lelitfunyelwe, ngako liyafihlwa esikhundleni sekulesula — kulesula bekutawubuya ekuvuselelweni lokulandzelako.
templates.start_from_sub: Lomsebenti akukabi naluhlelo, ngako lungabekwa ngetulu kwawo.

gates.title: Emasango etigaba
gates.subtitle: Loko lokufanele kube liciniso ngembi kwekutsi lomsebenti uchubeke.
gates.criteria_hint: Kubhalwe ngembi kwesincumo, hhayi ngemuva kwaso.
gates.waiver_needs_reason: Lisango leliyekelwe kufanele lisho kutsi ngobe. Kwendlula lelinye ngaphandle kwesizatfu kubika lokwesulwa kancane.
gates.none_hint: Ngaphandle kwelinye, sigaba lilebula lomunye lalishintjako.

site_records.title: Timbhalo tendzawo yemsebenti
site_records.subtitle: Imiyalo, kuhlolwa, kubuketwa nekucedza — emaphepha lesicelo sikhulunywa ngawo.
site_records.instructions_sub: Loko lotjelwe kutsi ukwente, nini, futsi ngubani
site_records.completion_sub: Ngekusebenta, ngetigaba nangekugcina — tisetifikethi letikhulula imali legciniwe
site_records.unconverted_title: Imiyalo lengu-{count} leceliwe njengenguculo kantsi ayikentiwa inguculo
site_records.unconverted_body: Ngulapho imali ilahleka khona ku-akhawundi yekugcina. Yentani inguculo, nome nisuse sicelo.
site_records.no_inspections_hint: Kwendlulwa ngunye ngiko lokugucula umsebenti lowucedziwe kutsi ube ngumsebenti lokufanele uphindze uvulwe.
site_records.no_completion_hint: Kucedza ngekusebenta kucala sikhatsi setici futsi kakhulu kukhulula incenye yemali legciniwe.
site_records.issued_by_hint: Unjiniyela nome ummeli welikhasimende — kakhulu hhayi umuntfu lone-akhawundi lapha.
site_records.variation_hint: Bhala umbono wakho nyalo, hhayi etinyangeni letitako nase-akhawundi iphikiswa.
site_records.instruction_sub: Yakhishwa ngembi kwekutsi lomunye avume kutsi yinguculo — ngiyo inhloso yayo.
site_records.element_hint: “Sisekelo sansi, sikhala 3” — kwanele kutsi uyitfole futsi.
site_records.fail_raises_ncr: Kuhlolwa lokwehlulekile kuvula kungalandzeli imitsetfo ngeko. Loko lokutselwe ngetulu kwako sekumbozwe, ngako loku akushiywa kubona kwalomunye.
site_records.requested_for_hint: Kubuketwa lokudzingeka namuhla kusihlwa akusiso satiso.
site_records.outstanding_hint: Luhlu loluhamba nesetifikethi. Kucedza ngekusebenta kunikwa nakusenemsebenti lousele — loko kujwayelekile.
site_records.certify_sub: Loku kukhulula imali legciniwe futsi kucala liwashi letici.
site_records.certify_note: Kucedza ngekusebenta kuyaliwa nangabe kunesici lesibalulekile nome kungalandzeli imitsetfo lokuvulekile eluhlwini — kucinisekisa ngetulu kwako kulahla litfuba lekukulungisa.
site_records.completion_blocked: Kunesici lesibalulekile nome kungalandzeli imitsetfo lokuvulekile lokungu-{count}. Kucedza ngekusebenta ngeke kucinisekiswe ngetulu kwako.

meetings.title: Imihlangano
meetings.subtitle: Luhlelo, timbhalo, kutsi ngubani labekhona, naloko lokufanele kwentiwe ngako.
meetings.project_hint: Tento tingaba yimisebenti kumsebenti kuphela, ngako umhlangano longenawo ugcina tento tawo etimbhalweni.
meetings.minutes_outstanding_title: Imihlangano lengu-{count} lebeyibanjwe ngaphandle kwekutsi timbhalo tisatjalaliswe
meetings.agenda_hint: Lutfunyelwa ngembi kwemhlangano; luba sakhiwo setimbhalo.
meetings.minutes_note: Lokungekhatsi kubhalwa netimbhalo ngenhloso: “kwavunyelwana emhlanganweni wendzawo yemsebenti” kuphikisana kuphela nangabe umbhalo usho kutsi ngubani labekhona kuvumelana nako.
meetings.actions_note: Tento tiba yimisebenti kumsebenti — sento lesiphila etimbhalweni kuphela sisento lesingenamuntfu losentako.
meetings.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” netimbhalo tawo tiyasuswa. Tento lesetentiwe tiba yimisebenti.

agile.title: Ema-sprint neluhlu lolulindzile
agile.subtitle: Tindzaba tiyimisebenti lejwayelekile, ngako libhodi, luhlelo nemaphepha esikhatsi konkhe kusasebenta.
agile.backlog_sub: Loko lokungahlelekile kuya phansi — intfo lengenamuntfu loyibeka embili ayibalulekile kwendlula.
agile.epics_sub: Umsebenti lowendlula ema-sprint. Inchubekela ngutindzaba tawo, hhayi silinganiso lesehlukile lesingase singavumelani nato.
agile.no_active_hint: Hlela lenye, ngenisa tindzaba kuyo, bese uyicala.
agile.no_goal: Akukho nhloso lebekiwe — i-sprint lengenayo libhokisi lesikhatsi kuphela.
agile.goal_hint: Umusho munye. Nangabe ungeke ukwati kuwubhala, i-sprint ayinanhloso.
agile.revision_hint: Ngaphandle kwako, “bekunani kulolu luhlobo” kucabangela etinyangeni letisitfupha letitako.
agile.close_note: Tindzaba letingakapheli tibuyela eluhlwini lolulindzile, hhayi embili kwe-sprint lelandzelako — kutidlulisela ngekwato yindlela i-sprint lelandzelako lecala ngayo isivele igcwele ngembi kwekutsi lomunye ayihlele.
agile.one_at_a_time: Lenye i-sprint isivele iyachubeka kulomsebenti. Letimbili ngasikhatsi sinye tenta lijubane nemgrafu wekucedza kungacaci.

portal.title: Imisebenti yakho
portal.subtitle: Loko lokwenteka emisebentini yakho, naloko lokudzinga wena.
portal.empty_body: Leli phothali likhombisa imisebenti lohlobene nayo njengelikhasimende nome njengenkontileki. Nangabe usebenta lapha, imisebenti yakho ingaphansi kwe-Misebenti.
portal.progress_note: Leli linombolo lelifanako naleli licembu lelentako lelibonako — akubalwa ngalokwehlukile kuwe.
portal.no_work: Akukho lokunikwe wena kuze kube manje.
portal.time_sub: Kwendlula ekuvunyweni lokufanako naleli lelikhasi lesikhatsi lelijwayelekile.
portal.documents_sub: Onkhe kulomsebenti lowatiko, nalapho ungasitfumela khona intfo
portal.rate_sub: Silinganiso sinye ngenyanga — siya ngco kulicembu lelentako.
portal.rate_dialog_sub: Kwetsembeka kusita kwendlula kuba nemusa. Akekho lolinganiswa ngaloku ngayedvwa.
portal.my_invoices_sub: Lungisa likhwelede lemsebenti wakho bese ulitsumela kumphatsi wephrojekthi.
portal.cinvoice_empty: Ngeta lokungenani umugca munye, nome unamatsisele likhwelede lakho, ngaphambi kwekulitsumela.
portal.cinvoice_sent: Lelikhwelede sevele litsunyelwe futsi angeke lisashintjwa.

assistant.title: Umsiti
assistant.subtitle: Loko idatha lekushoko kutsi kudzinga kunakwa nguwe, nelusito ngekubhala.
assistant.all_clear_hint: Wonkhe umsebenti losebentako uyabika, ungekhatsi kwetinkhomba tawo, futsi awunato tincumo letivinjelwe.
assistant.draft_sub: Tinombolo titsatfwa emsebentini; sibonelo sibhala emagama layitungeletako kuphela.
assistant.draft_warning: Luhlelo. Lufundze ngembi kwekutsi ulutfumele — tinombolo tingempela, imisho ayikabi yakho.
assistant.no_provider: Akukho munikati we-AI lobekiwe kulendzawo yemsebenti, ngako kubhala akutfolakali. Konkhe lokungenhla kubalwa kusuka kudatha yakho futsi akudzingi muntfu.
assistant.overloaded_detail: Emahora langu-{hours} lahleliwe enyangeni yemahora langu-{capacity}, emisebentini lengu-{projects}.
assistant.silent_title: Imisebenti lesebentako lengu-{count} ayibiki lutfo emavikini lamabili
assistant.silent_detail: Umsebenti longabiki lutfo akusiwo umsebenti lohamba kahle — ngulowo longenamuntfu longasho lutfo ngawo.
assistant.risk_title: Buningozi lobukhulu lobungu-{count} lobungenako kulungiswa lokubhaliwe
assistant.risk_detail: Bunemaphuzu langu-15 nome ngetulu, kantsi akukho lokubhaliwe ngaloko lokwentiwako.
assistant.change_title: Ticelo tenguculo letingu-{count} letilindze ngetulu kweliviki
assistant.change_detail: Titfunyelwe kantsi akukentiwa sincumo. Luhlelo nesincumo tiyehluka.
assistant.issue_detail: Tivulekile, tinikwe bantfu, futsi tendlulelwe sikhatsi.

alerts.deadline_title: Imisebenti lengu-{count} lephela emalangeni langu-{days} latako
alerts.overdue_title: Imisebenti lengu-{count} lesivele yendlulelwe lusuku lwayo
alerts.overdue_detail: Isavulekile, kantsi emalanga laseluhlelweni asengasho lutfo.

equipment.title: Kubuketwa kwemshini
equipment.sub: Kubuketwa ngembi kwekusetjentiswa — likhwalithi liluchungechunge lolungaphuki, hhayi lokukodvwa kwako
equipment.identifier_hint: Yiskene nome uyibhale. Ikhodi lengahambisani nalutfo efayeleni isafanele ibhalwe.
equipment.signed_hint: Ligama lakho, sikhatsi nelikheli lakho kuyabhalwa — njengekusayina lidokhumende.

contractors.title: Ema-invoyisi ebonkontileka
contractors.subtitle: Loko bonkontileka labakutfumele ngemsebenti wemaphrojekthi akho.
contractors.markup_hint: Akuphocelekile, futsi ayikaze ibonwe likhasimende nobe sonkontileka. Shiya kungenalutfo nangabe ingekho.
contractors.reject_sub: Sonkontileka ubonwa sizatfu sakho, ngako bhala intfo langatsatsa sinyatselo ngayo.
contractors.no_email: Lesonkontileka akanalo likheli le-imeyili, ngako inkontileka ayikwati kutfunyelwa.
contractors.not_submitted: Yi-invoyisi letfunyelwe kuphela lengavunywa nobe yenchatjwe.
contractors.register_sub: Wonkhe umuntfu lowenta naye inkontileka, nako konkhe ngaye.
contractors.add_sub: Libito labo nekutsi ungabatfola njani. Banikete phrojekthi bese batfola kufinyelela ephothali kute bakukhokhise.
contractors.from_suppliers: Leti tinkhomba takho tebaniki. Kwengeta lomunye lapha kumfaka naku-Supplier Management.
contractors.field_email_hint: Lapho simemo sabo sephothali siya khona.
contractors.on_projects: emaphrojekthi langu-{count} | iphrojekthi lengu-{count} | emaphrojekthi langu-{count}
contractors.our_signatory_hint: Batjelwa ku-app, futsi inkontileka ilindze sigiceshe sabo lapha.

contracts.title: Tinkontileka
contracts.subtitle: Tinkontileka temaphrojekthi — tibhalwa, tilungiswe, tibuketwe futsi tisayinwe lapha.
contracts.draft_sub: Cala kulesinye setifanekiso takho, nobe ungacali lutfo.
contracts.template_hint: Tifanekiso takho tephrojekthi. Shiya kungenalutfo kute utibhalele imibandzela.
contracts.title_hint: Shiya kungenalutfo kute libitwe ngekwesonkontileka nephrojekthi.
contracts.no_body_hint: Yilungise kute ubhale imibandzela, nobe ubhale lelandzelako ngesifanekiso.
contracts.amend_sub: Susa imibandzela lengasebenti, nobe ushintje emateminsi. Loku kubhala inguculo lensha.
contracts.amend_withdraws: Lenkontileka isaphumele kusayinwa. Kuyilungisa kuhoxisa emasiginesha lasacelwe, futsi emacembu atawucelwa kutsi asayine inguculo lensha.
contracts.change_note_hint: Kubhalwe kulenguculo — “kususwe umbandzela 7, akukho michini kulencenye”.
contracts.submit_explainer: Loku kuya kunobe ngubani inkhampani yakho lemmisele kuvuma tinkontileka. Nangabe kute tinyatselo tekuvuma letisethiwe, kuphawulwa njengalokuvunyiwe futsi kulungele kusayinwa.
contracts.signature_stale: Kusayinwe enguculweni yangaphambili. Emagama ashintjile kusukela lapho.
contracts.type_your_name_hint: Kuthayipha libito lakho lapha kusigiceshe sakho.
contracts.decline_reason_hint: Lelinye licembu liyakubona loku, futsi kufanele likwati kutsatsa sinyatselo.
contracts.send_explainer: {contractor} usayina kucala, bese umuntfu lomkhetsako ngentasi asayine naye.
contracts.closed: Inkontileka lesayiniwe nobe lekhanseliwe ayisakwati kushintjwa.
contracts.not_submittable: Luhlaka nobe inkontileka lenchatjwe kuphela lengatfunyelwa kute ibuketwe.
contracts.not_sendable: Inkontileka levunyiwe nobe leluhlaka kuphela lengatfunyelwa kute isayinwe.
contracts.no_counterparty: Lenkontileka ayinaye sonkontileka, ngako ayikwati kutfunyelwa.
contracts.no_signatory_email: Umsayini lokhetsiwe akanalo likheli le-imeyili, ngako inkontileka ayikwati kutfunyelwa.
contracts.mail_signature_line: Ukhetsiwe kutsi usayine inkontileka {number} na-{contractor} ku-{project}.
contracts.member_hint: Kutsi inkontileka ingubani. Kuyadzingeka ngaphambi kwekutsi itfunyelwe kute isayinwe.
contracts.no_contractors_on_project: Abakho bonkontileka kulephrojekthi — engeta lomunye kucala esikrinini sebonkontileka labancane.
contracts.name_alongside_drawing: Your name in text as well, so the record stays legible.
contracts.reopen_reason_hint: Every party who signed is told this.
contracts.reopen_warning: This contract is signed. Reopening tells everybody who signed, returns it to draft, and it must be signed again.
contracts.not_reopenable: Only a signed contract can be reopened.
contracts.reopen_reason_required: Say why the contract is being reopened.
contracts.not_yours_to_amend: This contract is not yours to change.
contracts.bad_signature_image: That signature could not be read.
contracts.signature_too_large: That signature image is too large.
contracts.mail_reopened_line: Contract {number} on {project} has been reopened for amendment.
contracts.mail_reopened_resign: The wording will change, so it will come back to you to sign again.
contracts.inapp_reopened: Contract {number} has been reopened for amendment.
contracts.need_drawing: Draw your signature above, or switch to Type.
contracts.bad_signed_pdf: Lelo lidokhumente lelisayiniwe alikhonanga kufundvwa njenge-PDF.
contracts.amendment_would_drop_tables: Lolushintjo lutawususa ematafula langu-{n} enkontilekeni — umhleli angeke awagcine. Hlela emagama kulenye indzawo, nome ucele kutsi litafula lishintjwe kusifanekiso.
contracts.sign_steps: Khetsa nome dweba sisayino, cindzetela lapho kufanele sibe elikhasini, bese usayina.
contracts.need_a_signature: Khetsa sisayino lesigcinwe, nome dweba sinye.
contracts.place_it_on_the_page: Cindzetela elikhasini lapho sisayino sakho kufanele sibe.
contracts.signing_failed: Inkontileka ayikhonanga kusayinwa. Sicela uzame futsi.
contracts.counterparty_has_no_login: Lomcondrakhi akanako kungena okwamanje, ngako bekangeke akhone kusayina. Memela yena kuphothali kucala.
contracts.signatory_cannot_sign: Leli licembu alinako kungena, ngako angeke likhone kusayina. Limemele kuphothali, bese utsumela inkontileka futsi.

contract_templates.title: Tifanekiso tetinkontileka
contract_templates.subtitle: Emagama lenkhampani leyenta ngawo tinkontileka letincane. Agcinwa lapha, ku-Project Management.
contract_templates.form_sub: Bhala imibandzela lejwayelekile kanye, bese uyilungisa ngekwesonkontileka ngamunye nawubhala.
contract_templates.none_hint: Bhala sinye, nobe ufake sethi yekucala nge-pm:contract-templates:install.
contract_templates.import_is_a_copy: Kungenisa kutsatsa likhophi. Kuyihlela lapha akusoze kushintje leyekucala, futsi ihlala ingeyakho nangabe i-Contract Management isusiwe.

steps.title: Emakholomu ebhodi
steps.subtitle: Nika emagama etinyatselo umsebenti wenu lowudlula kuwo. Sinyatselo ngasinye siphetse incazelo lefundvwa yiyo yonkhe imodyuli — inchubekela, kucedvwa neticelo konkhe kulandzela incazelo, hhayi ligama.
steps.needs_done: Sinyatselo lesisodvwa kufanele sibalwe njengaleCedziwe, ngaphandle kwaloko kute lokungacedvwa kulelibhodi.
steps.will_move: Imisebenti lengu-{count} isesinyatselweni losisusile. Itawuyiswa ekholomu yekucala.
steps.too_many: Libhodi linemkhawulo wemakholomu langu-{max}; ngetulu kwaloko kute longalifundza.
steps.bad_category: U-“{label}” kufanele abalwe njengalesinye setimo letakhiwe ngekhatsi.

reminders.mail_subject: Imisebenti yakho: {due} lefanele iphele namuhla, {overdue} lesekwedlule

billing.no_accounting: I-Accounting ayifakiwe, ngako akukho lokungatfunyelwa ku-ledger.
billing.no_party: Alikho likhasimende letibalo lelifana na-"{client}" — yakha lelinye, nome uhlanganise lokuphindzaphindziwe.

data_sources.title: Imitfombo yemniningwane
data_sources.subtitle: Imitfombo lena inkhampani leciniseka ngayo bahlinteki, loko umtfombo ngamunye longakuphendvula, nekuhlola lokungakaphendvulwa ngumuntfu.
data_sources.ledger_broken: Luchungechunge lwebufakazi alusahambisani esibhalweni {at} ({reason}). Tsatsa bufakazi lobutsintsekako njengalobungakacinisekiswa kuze kuphenywe.
data_sources.coverage_help: Konkhe kuhlola lemojuli leyatiko kukwenta, nekutsi ngubani lokuphendvulako lamuhla. Kuhlola lokungenamtfombo akweqiwa — kubhalwa njengalokungatfolakali kuze kube nemuntfu lokwentako abhale lakutfolile.
data_sources.manual_notice: Kuhlola lokungu-{count} akunamtfombo lolungisiwe, ngako umuntfu kufanele akwente abhale lakutfolile.
data_sources.enable_help: Nangabe loku kuvaliwe, kuhlola lebekutophendvulwa ngiko kubhalwa njengalokungatfolakali esikhundleni sekuphumelela.
data_sources.credentials_help: Kubhalwe ngemkhandlu lapho kugcinwe khona futsi akukaze kubuyiselwe kulesikrini. Ngenisa sikhiya kute usishintje; tikhiya longakatibhali kabusha tiyagcinwa.
data_sources.default_for_help: Lapho imitfombo lengetulu kwemunye ingaphendvula kuhlola, lona ubutwa kucala.
data_sources.monthly_quota_help: Imitfombo lekhokhelwako ibita imali ngemkhulumo ngamunye. Nangabe sabelo sesiphelile, kuhlola kubhalwa njengalokungatfolakali esikhundleni sekukukhokhisa.
data_sources.endpoints_help: Likheli i-akhawunti yakho legunyatiwe leyiniketa kuhlola ngakunye. Tindzawo tekugcwalisa tigcwaliswa kusuka kumhlinteki.
data_sources.endpoint_hint: Tindzawo tekugcwalisa: registration_number, company_name, vat_number, tax_reference_number, account_number, reference
data_sources.manual_provider_note: Kuhlala kutfolakala. Umuntfu wenta kuhlola emtfonjeni abhale lakutfolile — kungena kuloluhlu lwekubuka lolufanako, nebufakazi lobufanako, kubhalwe egameni lakhe.
data_sources.profiled: Kuhlola lokungu-{count} sekwati kutsi kushayela kuphi. Faka imininingwane yakho futsi kutawusebenta — emasimi langenentasi ngewenkontileka lehlukile kuphela.

verifications.title: Kuphenya lokujulile
verifications.outstanding: Kuhlola lokungu-{count} kusadzinga kunakwa ngaphambi kwekutsi lomhlinteki atsatfwe njengalocinisekisiwe.
verifications.record_help: Kwekuhlola lokwente wena emtfonjeni. Kugcinwa nebufakazi lobufanako naloko lokwentiwe ngumshini, kubhalwe egameni lakho — kuze kungabi khona lokutsatsa njengemphendvulo lecinisekiswe ngumshini.
verifications.observed_help: Bhala loko umtfombo lokuvete ngempela. Kucatsaniswa naloko umhlinteki lasitjele kona, libala nelibala, kuze umehluko utfolakale esikhundleni sekwemukelwa ngekwetsemba.
verifications.pin_held: I-PIN ibanjelwe lomhlinteki, ngako simo sabo sekutfobela intsela singacinisekiswa.
verifications.pin_missing: Kute i-PIN nyalo. I-PIN ye-TCS yemhlinteki yimvume yabo yekutsi uciniseke simo sabo sekutfobela intsela.
verifications.pin_help: Igcinwe ibhalwe ngemkhandlu, isetjentiselwa kuphela kuciniseka simo sekutfobela intsela. Kuciniseka kubhala loko i-SARS lekushito ngesikhatsi kubutwa — ngiko loku kungasiko kulayisha satifiketi.

errors.no_source: Kute umtfombo lolungiselelwe u-{check}, ngako angeke kusebente ngekutentakalela. Bhala kuhlola wena, nome ulungise umtfombo ku-Lungisa → Imitfombo yemniningwane.

ownership.title: Bunikati
ownership.no_ubos: Kute umuntfu wemvelo lotfolakele. Kuze luchungechunge lufike ebantfwini, kute longahlolwa — inkhampani ayikwati kujeziswa futsi ayikwati kuba yi-PEP.
ownership.diagram_alt: Umdvwebo webunikati. Lwati lolufanako lusethebuleni lelingentansi kwawo.
ownership.table_caption: Onkhe emasabelo ebunikati labhaliwe. Lelithebula sitfombe lesigcwele — umdvwebo longenhla ukhombisa buhlobo lobufanako.
ownership.as_at_help: Lilanga lapho lesabelo besiliciniso ngalo. Sibhalo sebunikati lesingenalo lilanga sikubeka lokungachazi sikhatsi lesitsite.
ownership.unallocated: {entity}: u-{missing}% wemasheya awuchazwanga. Ukhona lowubambile longakabitwa ngelibito.
ownership.unstated_stakes: {entity}: emasabelo langu-{n} labhalwe ngaphandle kwebukhulu, ngako emasheya angeke acaciswe.
ownership.over_allocated: {entity}: emasabelo lamenyetiwe afika ku-{declared}%, lokungetulu kwenkhampani yonkhe.
ownership.related_help: Bahlinteki labanemuntfu nome inkhampani lebambile lefanako nalona. Ngalokuvamile akunalicala — futsi kuyindlela licembu linye lelifaka ngayo litendela ngemabito lamatsatfu.
ownership.owns_what_help: Umhlinteki ngekwakhe, nome inkhampani lesetulu eluchungechungeni.
ownership.compare_help: Faka banikati labatfola inzuzo njengoba rejista ibabhala. Bacatsaniswa nebantfu luchungechunge lwalomhlinteki lolufika kubo — ligebe emkhatsini walamaluhlu lamabili ngiko lokutfoliwe.

risk.title: Kuhlolwa kwengoti

inspections.critical_hint: Umbuto lobalulekile lolwehlulekako wehlulisa konkhe kuhlolwa.
inspections.code_hint: Tinhlamvu letinkhulu, tinombolo nemagwegwe — sib. CON-SCAFFOLD
inspections.need_template_first: Udzinga lithempulethi lelishicelelwe ngembi kwekutsi kuhlelwe lokutsite.
inspections.install_library: Ilabhulali lelivamile lemacheklisti langu-20 etimbonini letilishumi lifakwa ngekutentekela. Nangabe lisenalutfo, buta umphatsi wesistimu kutsi afake ilabhulali ye-SHEQ.

investigations.title: Luphenyo
investigations.subtitle: Lokwentekile, kungani kwenteka, naloko lokuvimbela kutsi kuphindze kwenteke
investigations.heading: Luphenyo
investigations.none_open: Akukho lokuphenywako. Tehlakalo tivela lapha nangabe tibikiwe.
investigations.only_blames_people: Tonkhe timbangela letisemcoka tisola umuntfu. Bheka simo lesikuvumele loko.
investigations.depth_hint: Kujula kulandzela bunzima lobungenteka, hhayi lokwentekile.
investigations.confirm_body_approve: Kugunyata kwemukela imbangela lesemcoka njengalokutfoliwe kwenhlangano.
investigations.confirm_body_close: Kuvala kubhala kutsi inhlangano seyibhekene naloku.
investigations.confirm_body_reopen: Kwentiwa kubuketwa lokusha. Lokukhona kugcinwa njengoba kunjalo.

ai.title: Sikhulu Sekuphepha se-AI
ai.subtitle: Timbhalo letilungiswe ngumsiti, tilindzele sincumo semuntfu.
ai.boundary_body: Umsiti uyaphakamisa; akabhali. Akukho lokukuleli khasi lokunemtselela kuze ube uyakwemukela, futsi ligama lakho lifakwa kuloko lokwemukelako.
ai.unverified_waiting: Timbhalo letingu-{count} tenta timphikiso letingenawo umtfombo lowesekelako. Leto tibhalwe kucala.
ai.queue_empty: Akukho lokulindzele. Timbhalo tivela lapha nangabe umsiti acelwa.
ai.no_source: Akukho mtfombo lowesekelako — hlola loku ngaphambi kwekwemukela
ai.note_hint: Kuyadzingeka kute wale. Kusibonakaliso lesicacile sekutsi umsiti uphambuka kuphi.
ai.never_body: Letincumo tinemtfwalo wemtsetfo wemuntfu ngayedvwa. Tigcinelwe umuntfu lobitiwe futsi umsiti uvinjelwe kuto ngekhodi, hhayi nje kutjelwa kutsi atigweme.
ai.chat_scope: Timphendvulo tivela emarekhodini e-SHEQ nasetintfweni talenkampani. Akukho lapha lokushintja irekhodi.

approvals.title: Timvume
approvals.subtitle: Tincumo letikulindzele, netcelo lotifakile.
approvals.designer_subtitle: Klama kutsi ngubani lovuma ini, ngenkhampani.
approvals.versioned: Ticelo lesetivele tichubeka tigcina tinyatselo letitcale ngato.

audits.title: Kuhlolwa
audits.subtitle: Kuhlolwa kwangekhatsi, kwebahlinteki nekucinisekisa.
audits.root_cause_hint: Kungani kwentekile — hhayi kutsi wentenjani ngako.

suppliers.title: Kubhaliswa kwebahlinteki
suppliers.subtitle: Kuhlolwa kwe-SHEQ ngaphambi kwekutsi umhlinteki asebente endzaweni.
suppliers.invite_note: Simemo sibalula emadokhumente lokumele akhishwe nguleli zinga lengoti, kute atfunyelwe kanye esikhundleni sekutfolakala ngekwaliwa ngakunye.

ppe.title: PPE
ppe.subtitle: Lokukhishiwe, kubani, nekutsi kufanele kushintjwe nini.
ppe.empty_catalogue: Akukho lutfo kulikhathalogu okwamanje, ngako akukho lokungakhishwa. Sebentisa u-“Phatsa likhathalogu nesitokwe” kungeta tintfo lelenkhampani etikhishako — tincabule, ticoco tekuvikela, emaglavu — futsi ubeke kutsi kungaki lokuse sheluvu.
ppe.issue_note: Lokuniketiwe, kuniketwe bani. Lusuku lwekushintja luphuma esikhatsini sekuphila kwentfo.
ppe.serial_hint: Kutintfo letihlolwa nome letibuyiselwa ngayinye, njengelibhandi lekutivikela.

medical.title: Kuhlolwa kwetemphilo
medical.subtitle: Kufanelana nemsebenti, nekuhlolwa lokutako.
medical.clinical_hint: Lwati lwetemphilo. Lubhalwe ngemakhodi, futsi lubonakala kuphela ngemvume yedatha yetemphilo.
medical.clinical_failed: Imininingwane yetekwelapha ayikhonanga kulayishwa. Akukho lokukhonjiswako esikhundleni selirekhodi lelingenalutfo, lelingafundzeka njengekungabi khona kwalokutfolakele.
medical.clinical_warning: Imininingwane yetemphilo ngaphansi kwe-POPIA s26. Kuyifundza kubhalwa ku-akhawunti yakho.
medical.record_note: Kuhlolwa lokwentiwe. Imininingwane yetemphilo igcinwa yodvwa futsi ifundvwa kuphela ngulabo labanelilungelo.
medical.expires_hint: Yishiye ingenalutfo kute kusetjentiswe sikhatsi sekusebenta lesibekelwe loku kuhlolwa.
medical.restrictions_hint: Kuyadzingeka. Umkhawulo longabhalwanga ushiya umphatsi acabanga.
medical.clinical_encrypted: Kubhalwe ngemakhodi lapho kugcinwe khona futsi kufundvwa kuphela ngulabo labanelilungelo lemininingwane yetemphilo.

environmental.title: Imvelo
environmental.subtitle: Emanti, emandla, uphethiloli, imfucuta nekhabhoni.
environmental.no_factor: Lamamitha akanaso silinganiso sekukhipha, ngako akangeti lutfo enanini lelikhabhoni:
environmental.record_note: Kufundvwa kwemitha, kunelusuku. Linani lelipheleleko lekhabhoni libalwa kabusha kusuka kulo kusetjentiswa sikali sekukhipha semitha.

equipment.title: Timishini tekuphepha
equipment.subtitle: Ticimamlilo, emabhandi, timishini tekuphakamisa nelusito lwekucala.

visitors.title: Tivakashi
visitors.subtitle: Imvume, singeniso, nekutsi ngubani lokhona nyalo.
visitors.roll_call: Loku luhlu lwekubita emagama. Ngemuva kwe-alamu, ngiwo kuphela luhlu lolubalulekile.
visitors.no_workflow_detail: Akukho ndlela yekuvuma bavakashi, ngako kute lonelilungelo lekungenisa umuntfu. Hlela yinye kucala.
visitors.request_note: Kuvakasha kumele kuvunywe ngaphambi kwekutsi kungene umuntfu, ngako loku kusicelo hhayi kufika.
visitors.expected_to_hint: Ngemuva kwalesi sikhatsi sivakashi sibhalwa njengalesihlala sikhatsi lesidze.

emergency.title: Simo lesiphutfumako
emergency.subtitle: Emasu, tindzawo tekuhlangana nekusebenta kwekutilolonga.
emergency.uncovered: Akukho luhlelo lwesimo lesiphutjumako lolubhalelwe: {types}. Akekho lonenchubo langayilandela kuloku.
emergency.record_drill_note: Kutilolonga lokwentiwe. Linani lalabangatfolakali ngilo lelincuma kutsi kuphumelele yini.

training.title: Kucecesha kwekuphepha
training.subtitle: Kufundvwa ku-Learning Management. Emarekhodi akaphindvwa lapha.
training.unavailable: I-Learning Management ayifakiwe, ngako ayikho idatha yekucecesha lengaboniswa.

integrations.title: Kuhlanganiswa kwelisango
integrations.subtitle: Hlumanisa luhlelo lwakho lwekulawula kungena nome lwekuklokha. Faka ticiniseko, hlola, bese ugcilitela.
integrations.none: Akukho kuhlumana okwamanje. Ngeta kunye kucala kuhlola bantfu elisangweni.
integrations.label: Ligama
integrations.monitor_first: Kuhlumana lokusha kucala ngemodi yekubuka: kwala kuyabhalwa kodvwa akekho lovinjwako. Kubuke liviki, ususe lokusalele, bese ugcilitela.
integrations.enforce_warning: Kusukela manje, bantfu labehlulekako ekuhlolweni batawuvinjwa elisangweni. Kusukela emalangeni langu-30 lendlulile, kungena langu-{refused} bekutawaliwa. Ciniseka kutsi loko lokusalele kususwa kucala.

inductions.title: Kwetfulwa
inductions.subtitle: Lokutjelwa bantfu ngaphambi kwekutsi banyatsele endzaweni.
inductions.author: Bhala kwetfulwa
inductions.bulk_how: Dawuniloda sifanekiso, sigcwalise, usilayishe. Hlola kucala — akukho lokugcinwako kuze ucindzetele i-Ngenisa.

talks.title: Tingcoco tekuphepha
talks.subtitle: Lokutjelwe licembu, bobani lebebakhona, nalokho labakuphakamisile.
talks.attendees_hint: Kuyadingeka. Ingcoco lengenabantfu lebebakhona ifakazela kutsi sihlelile lokutsite, hhayi kutsi kukhona lotjelwe.
talks.concerns_hint: Nome yini lephakanyiswe lapha iba sento, ngako ayilahleki nangabe ingcoco iphela.
talks.record_note: Inkhulumo lengenalo luhla lwalabebakhona ifakazela kutsi kwalungiswa lokutsite, hhayi kutsi kukhona lowatiswa.

ppe_config.title: Ikhathalogi nesitoko se-PPE
ppe_config.subtitle: Loko lenkampani lekukhiphako, nekutsi kungakanani lokusesheluvini.
ppe_config.empty_help: Ayikho intfo ekhathalogi njengamanje. Ngeta tintfo lenkampani letikhiphako — ticatfulo, tigcoko tekuphepha, emagilavu — bese ubeka kutsi tingaki esheluvini. Irejista yekukhipha ifundza lapha.
ppe_config.low_warning: Imigca yesitoko lengu-{n} isezingeni lekuyala nobe ngentasi kwalo.
ppe_config.sized_hint: Maka loku nangabe intfo ikhishwa ngemasayizi, kuze sitoko sibalwe ngesayizi ngasinye.
ppe_config.reorder_hint: Yecwayisa nangabe linani lehla lifika lapha
ppe_config.site_hint: Shiya kungenalutfo nangabe sitoko singagcinwa ngendzawo
ppe_config.stock_hint: Umugca munye ngentfo ngayinye, sayizi nendzawo. I-PPE lenesayizi ibalwa ngesayizi, ngobe kuphelelwa ngusayizi munye akufani nekuphelelwa yintfo.

import.title: Ngenisa tintfo te-PPE
import.subtitle: Layisha ikhathalogu kusuka kuspredishithi esikhundleni sekuyithayipha.
import.matched_on_code: Tintfo tifananiswa ngekhodi — ikhodi lekhona iyabuyeketwa, ayiphindzaphindzwa.

reports.title: Imibiko
reports.subtitle: Onkhe emarejista lasemojulini, njengombiko longawuhlunga uwutfumele.
reports.not_periodic: Lombiko uchaza simo njengamanje, ngako sikhatsi asisebenti.

help.incidents_by_type: Mangaki aloluhlobo ngalunye, mangaki lekufanele abikwe, nemalanga lalahlekile.
help.incidents_detail: Tonkhe tehlakalo kulesikhatsi, umugca munye ngasinye.
help.actions_overdue: Sekwendlule lusuku lwato futsi atikacedvwa — luhlu lokufanele lusetjentwe.
help.ppe_issued: Lokwakhishwa, kukhishelwa bani, nekutsi kufanele kushintjwe nini.
help.ppe_usage_by_item: Kusetjentiswa ngentfo — lokufanele kubhajethwe futsi ku-odwe kabusha.
help.ppe_replacements_due: I-PPE lekhishiwe lefika ekugcineni kwemphilo yayo.
help.ppe_stock: Lokusesheluvini, nekutsi yini lesewele ezingeni lekuyala.
help.inductions_completed: Ngubani lowetfulwa, emaphuzu akhe, nekutsi kuphela nini.
help.visitors: Ngubani lowefika endzaweni kulesikhatsi, nekutsi wahamba nini.
help.visitors_on_site: Wonkhe umuntfu longenile longaphumanga — luhlu lwekubalwa kwebantfu.
help.permits: Timvume letikhishwe kulesikhatsi nesimo sato samanje.
help.emergency_drills: Kutilolonga lokwentiwe, kutsatsa sicalo nesikhatsi sekuphuma.
help.environmental_readings: Kufundvwa kwemitha nekutsi kuguculwa kube yi-CO₂e lengakanani.
help.contractors_access: Kutsi umcashi ngamunye angaba yini endzaweni njengamanje.

approvals_setup.edit_hint: Kugcina kwakha luhlobo {n}. Ticelo lesetichubeka tigcina tinyatselo letacala ngato.
approvals_setup.retire_confirm: Tsatsisa u-“{name}” umhlalaphansi? Iyekela kusetjentiswa kulokusha. Ticelo lesetichubeka tiyayigcina futsi tingacedvwa.

hints.permit: Ngubani losayina imvume ngaphambi kwekucala umsebenti

sites.add_sub: Indzawo lapho kwentiwa khona umsebenti lengekho kusakhiwo senkampani — indlu yekugcina leciniselwe, indzawo yelikhasimende, incenye yemgwaco.
sites.structure_warning: Ligama nekutsi iyasebenta yini kubekwa sisakhiwo senkampani futsi kutawubuyiselwa ekuvumelaniseni lokulandzelako. Konkhe lokunye kuhlala.
sites.hint_timezone: Imikhawulo yesikhatsi yemtsetfo ibalwa kulesi sikhatsi
sites.hint_reference: Inombolo yenkontileka nobe yemsebenti, nangabe isita
sites.requirements_hint: Indzawo yekucwenga nelihhovisi akufanele kudzinge emaphepha lafanako. Setha luhlu lwalendzawo, nome uyiyekele ilandzele inkampani.
sites.requirements_inherit_hint: Kulandzela kusho kutsi lendzawo iyashintja nangabe luhlu lwenkampani lushintja. Kukucisha akuvimbi lutho — indzawo nje isho lwayo.
sites.requirements_none_warning: Nangabe kungamakiwe lutho, nome ngumuphi umcondrakhi kulendzawo uhambisana nemitsetfo ngaleso sikhatsi abhalisiwe.

triage.title: Lulayini lwekuhlunga
triage.subtitle: Tigameko letimele kutsi umuntfu atitsatse, umnyaka losedvute kucala.
triage.dialog_help: Cinisekisa kutsi bekungaba kubi kanganani bese ubita lotawukucedza. Kushintja lizinga kushintja lusuku.

alert.title: Tecwayiso tekuphepha
alert.subtitle: Kuyisa lokutfoliwe kubantfu labasengotini lefanako.
alert.needs_why: Sho kutsi kungani kwentekile nome yini leshintjiwe ngembi kwekukhipha.

injury.title: Emacala ekulimala
injury.subtitle: Ngubani longekho emsebentini, ngubani losemsebentini lolula, nangubani lobuyile.
injury.still_running: Lomuntfu unesikhatsi lesivulekile ngaphandle kwelusuku lekugcina, ngako emalanga asabalwa.
injury.event_hint: Kuphumula nemsebenti lolula kubala emalanga. Lokunye kungumlandvo wekunakekelwa.

permit.no_approvals: Akukho tinyatselo tekugunyata letilungiselelwe loluhlobo lwemvume.
permit.suspend_hint: Licembu libona lesisizatfu, ngako sho kutsi kumele kulungiswe ini ngaphambi kwekutsi umsebenti uchubeke.
permit.override_warning: Uyemukela, egameni lakho, kutsi umuntfu angenta umsebenti angenalo lithikithi lawo njengamanje. Loku kubhalwa emvumeni nasemkhondweni wekuhlola.

board.title: Libhodi Letimvume Lelibukhoma
board.subtitle: Umsebenti losemagunyeni labhalwe njengamanje
board.uncovered: Timvume letibukhoma letingu-{count} atinakuhlola kwengoti lokugunyatiwe lokumboza indzawo. Ligunya lemvume lemile kulo alikho.
board.empty: Akukho timvume letibukhoma. Akukho lutfo lolusetjentwa ngeligunya lelibhalwe njengamanje.

ra.needs_lines: Ngeta lokungenani mudvwa munye wengoti ngaphambi kwekutsi loku kugunyatwe.
ra.needs_participants: Bhala kutsi bobani lababambe lichaza ngaphambi kwekutsi kugunyatwe — iMitsetfo yekwaKha ne-MHSA bobabili bakudinga.
ra.weak_control_line: Mudvwa {sequence}: {hazard} iyingoti lephakeme nome lebucayi lelawulwa kuphela ngetinyatselo tekuphatsa nome tivikelo temuntfu.
ra.approved_locked: Kuhlola lokugunyatiwe angeke kuhlelwe. Kunaloko dala kubuketwa kabusha; lenguculo ihlala elirekhodini ngobe tigameko tehlulelwa ngayo.
ra.no_lines: Akukho midvwa yengoti okwamanje. Kuhlola lokungenamidvwa kuvimba yonkhe imvume lekubhekisa kuko.
ra.participants_hint: Bantfu labenta umsebenti kumele babambe lichaza ekuhloleni ingoti yawo.
ra.controls_hint: Lesinemandla kucala. Ingoti lephakeme lebanjwe kuphela ngetinyatselo tekuphatsa nome tivikelo temuntfu iyaphawulwa.

contractor.subtitle: Kutsi laba bantfu bangaba endzaweni nome cha, nekutsi yini lebavimbako
contractor.blocked_title: Laba bantfu angeke beta endzaweni okwamanje
contractor.title: Sihloko
contractor.expiry_hint: Shiya lusuku lwekuphela kungagcwaliswanga kulidokhumente lelingapheli. Lidokhumente lelendlulile lusuku lwalo lwekuphela livimba kungena.
contractor.induction_hint: Kwetfulwa lokuphelelwe sikhatsi kubalwa njengekungekho, futsi kusizatfu lesivame kakhulu sekutsi sisebenti sibuyiselwe esangweni.
contractor.override_warning: Uyemukela, egameni lakho, kutsi laba bantfu bangaba endzaweni ngaphandle kwemadokhumente lafunwa ngulendzawo. Niketa lusuku — kwendlulisa lokungenakuphela kuba kwaphakadze ngeliphutsa.
contractor.drop_hint: Lamanyenti ngasikhatsi sinye, nome i-zip yinye lephetse lifayela lekuphepha lonkhe — ivulwa ibe lidokhumente lelilodvwa ngelifayela ngalinye.
contractor.photo_hint: Indlela lendlu yelisango yati ngayo kutsi umuntfu lose sangweni nguye umuntfu losehlwini.
contractor.not_linked: Akuhlunyaniswanga nelirekhodi lekuPhatsa baHlinzeki, ngako lifayela labo lekuphepha nelirekhodi labo letekuhwebelana angeke afundwe ngekucatsanisa.
contractor.no_assessment: Akukho kuhlolwa kwe-SHEQ lokwentiwe ngaseceleni letekuhwebelana.
contractor.set_aside_note: Lidokhumente lihlala efayeleni njengebufakazi futsi liyekela kubalwa ekuhambisana. Sebentisa loku kulungisa lusuku lwekuphela lolungalungile: kunanyatsisela sitifikethi lesifanele akwenele ngekwaso, ngobe kuhlola kugcina nome ngulini lidokhumente leliphela ekugcineni.
contractor.set_aside_hint: Kubhalwe egameni lakho. Umbuketi lobuta kutsi kungani sitifikethi siyekele kubalwa ufundza loku.
contractor.pass_hint: Lisango liskena loku bese litfola imphendulo lebukhoma. Likhodi aliphetse lutfo ngaphandle kwesikhombisi — akukho inombolo yemazisi, akukho mniningwane yetemphilo, akukho sitifikethi — ngako kuhlala kuphephile kuphrinta, kutfwebula nekudlulisa.
contractor.worker_site_hint: Yishiye ingenalutfo kute ilandele indzawo yemsebenti yemcontraki.
contractor.pass_rotate_warning: Likhadi leliphrintiwe liyekela kusebenta masinyane futsi kumele kukhishwe lelisha. Sebentisa loku nangabe likhadi lilahlekile nome umuntfu asahambile.
contractor.sites_hint: Kuvunywa kwendzawo yinye akusiko kuvunywa kwalenye. Indzawo levimba lomcontraki iyamnqabela lapho nome ngabe lifayela lakhe litsini kuletinye tindzawo.
contractor.sites_none: Atikho tindzawo letisebentako lokufanele kuncunywe ngato njengamanje.
contractor.site_conditions_hint: Iphrintwa esincumweni selisango nangabe likhadi labo liskenwa lapha. Sibonelo: bapheleketelwe sonkhe sikhatsi, emini kuphela.
contractor.site_reason_required: Kuyadzingeka. Kuvinjwa lokungenasizatfu akukho muntfu longakususa.
contractor.site_block_warning: Loku kubanqabela kulendzawo kuphela, futsi kubanqabela nome ngabe simo sabo senkampani yonkhe sitsini.

files.drop_hint: nome cindzetela kukhetsa. I-zip ivulwa ibe lirekhodi lelilodvwa ngelifayela ngalinye lelingekhatsi.

library.title: Lilayibhulali lemadokhumente
library.subtitle: Tinchubo letisebentako, njengobe tisebenta kuwe
library.owing: Emadokhumente langu-{count} alindze kutsi ucinisekise kutsi uwafundzile.
library.watermark_note: Likhophi ngalinye liphetse inguculo yalo, lusuku lwekushicilela neluphawu lwelikhophi lelingalawulwa. Likhophi leliphrintiwe lisebenta kuphela ngelusuku lelaphrintwa ngalo.

exposure.title: Emahora Lasetjentiwe
exposure.subtitle: Kuvetwa lokuhlukaniswa ngako onkhe emazinga ekulimala
exposure.site_hint: Shiya kungagcwaliswanga kwinkhampani yonkhe. Tfwebula ngendzawo kuphela nangabe ubika ngendzawo.
exposure.basis_hint: Lapho linani livela khona. Nome yini ngaphandle kwelinani lelifakwe ngesandla yenta emazinga yenyanga akwati kuhlolwa.
exposure.estimated_note: Tinyanga letingu-{count} tincike kulinani lelifakwe ngesandla, ngako emazinga ato tilinganiso.
exposure.missing: Tinyanga letingu-{count} atinemahora, ngako i-LTIFR, i-TRIR, i-DIFR nelizinga lebukhulu angeke kubalwe kuto.
exposure.footnote: Emazinga ngemahora langu-200 000 lasetjentiwe. Inyanga lengenemahora iyashiywa elizingeni lemnyaka kunekubalwa njengo-0.

mine.title: Lapho Ngimi Khona
mine.subtitle: Emathikithi ami, kuhlolwa kwemphilo nekufundza, njengobe luhlelo lunako
mine.no_record: Awunalo lirekhodi lesisebenti okwamanje, ngako akukho lutfo lolusefayeleni longalukhombisa. Cela loyo lowasungula i-akhawunti yakho akufake eluhlwini lwetisebenti — kuze kube ngulesikhatsi, luhlelo angeke lukutjele lapho umi khona, futsi angeke luciniseke.
mine.nothing_on_file: Akukho lokubhalwe ngawe okwamanje, futsi akukho lokufunwe kuwe. Loku akufani nekuhambisana — kusho kutsi akukho lutfo lokumele kuhlolwe.
mine.blocking: {count} emathikithi akho aphelelwe sikhatsi futsi akuvimba kusebenta. Angeke ukhishelwe imvume nome usayinwe emsebentini kuze kube luvuselelwe.
mine.gaps_hint: Loku kufunwe kuwe futsi akukho lirekhodi ngako. Lithikithi leliphelelwe sikhatsi lidzinga kuvuselelwa; loku kumele kuhlelwe.
mine.induction_not_current: Kwetfulwa kwakho kwendzawo akusekho esikhatsini. Ungase ubuyiselwe esangweni.
mine.unacknowledged: Tinchubo letingu-{count} tilindze kutsi ucinisekise kutsi utifundzile
mine.footnote: Leli lirekhodi lelifanako lelifundvwa tincwadzi tekubhalisa nelisango. Nangabe lokutsite lapha kungalungi, kungalungi yonkhe indzawo — tjela sikhulu sakho sekuphepha kunekutsi usebente ngendlela letungeleta.

matrix.title: Imethrikisi Yemakhono
matrix.subtitle: Ngubani lofanelekele ini, nalapho sishoda khona
matrix.no_gaps: Onkhe likhono lelidingekako liphetfwe ngibo bonkhe lelidingeka kubo.
matrix.capped: Kukhombisa bantfu labangu-{shown} kulabangu-{total}. Ligridi libanti ngekwemvelo, ngako lincunyelwe.
matrix.nothing_required: Akukho likhono lesalidingwe kunome ngubani. Loku akufani nekutsi wonkhe umuntfu uyahambisana — kusho kutsi akukho lokungahlolwa ngako.
matrix.footnote: Tidingo letinanyatsiselwe endimeni, emnyangweni nome endzaweni titilungiswa lapho lowo mongo watiwa; leligridi likhombisa leto letinanyatsiselwe kubantfu ngco. Lithikithi leliphelelwa sikhatsi lisabalwa njengeleliphetfwe — lisebenta lamuhla.

safety_file.title: Lifayela Lekuphepha
safety_file.subtitle: Sonkhe sigaba lesifunwa ngulomnikati wendzawo, nalokukhona kuso ngasinye.
safety_file.nothing_required: Akukho sigaba lesisafunwa, ngako lifayela angeke libe liphelele nome lingaphelele. Khetsa iphrofayela yemkhakha wakho bese uyilungisa — nguloko lokusho kutsi ngutiphi tigaba letibalulekile lapha.
safety_file.complete: Sonkhe sigaba lesifunwako sigculisekile. Lelifayela alidingi likhophi lelilicwecwe.
safety_file.history_count: {count} lekurekhodiwe. Lesigaba simlandvo kunekutsi sibe bufakazi, ngako akudingeki sigcwaliswe.
safety_file.drop_hint: Yehlisa tisetifikethi lapha. Ifolda ye-zip ivulwa ibe lidokhumente lelilodvwa ngelifayela ngalinye.
safety_file.reason_hint: Kubhalwe egameni lakho, futsi umcondrakhi uyatjelwa kutsi kutsiteni.
safety_file.valid_until_hint: Shiya kungagcwaliswanga kutfola tinyanga letingu-{months} kusukela lamuhla. Liphuma ekugunyatweni ngalolusuku nome kukhona lovula sikrini nome akekho.
safety_file.reject_hint: Umcondrakhi kumele atjelwe kutsi akalungise ini. Kwala ngaphandle kwesizatfu kucala lucingo kunekutsi kucale lidokhumente lelilungisiwe.
safety_file.warning_days_hint: Shiya kungagcwaliswanga kusebentisa lokubekiwe. Kubeke ngesikhatsi lesidingekako ngempela kushintja leli dokhumente.
safety_file.site_hint: Shiya kungagcwaliswanga nangabe kusebenta kuto tonkhe tindzawo. Lidokhumente lendzawo letsite akumele livimbe umcondrakhi kuletinye tindzawo.
safety_file.activities_hint: Shiya kungagcwaliswanga nangabe kusebenta kuwo wonkhe umsebenti. Lithikithi lekuphakamisa libalulekile ekuphakamiseni, hhayi ekupendeni.
safety_file.filed_as_hint: Kulethwe kusho kutsi lifikile futsi kusemele lihlolwe ngumuntfu. Aligculisi lutfo kuze kube liyemukelwa.

state_hint.APPROVED: Umuntfu lonelikhono wemukele lelifayela. Liyekela kusebenta ngelusuku lolungentasi.
state_hint.SUSPENDED: Alialwa, kodvwa alisebenti nje futsi. Bantfu babo bayalelwa esangweni.
state_hint.EXPIRED: Kugunyatwa kuphelelwe sikhatsi. Kumele kutsunyelwe lifayela lelisha.

move_hint.submit: Linika lifayela kunome ngubani lobuketa emafayela ebocondrakhi lapha. Angeke litsunyelwe ngesikhatsi sigaba lesifunwako singagculisekile.
move_hint.request_changes: Libuyisa neluhla lwaloko lokumele kushintje. Lokulandelako lokutsunyelwa ngumcondrakhi kuyinguculo lensha, futsi loku kugcina sizatfu sakho.
move_hint.approve: Lemukela lifayela njengaloku limile lamuhla. Kugunyatwa kusitatimende mayelana nemadokhumente lakulo ngalolusuku, ngako kuphatsa lusuku lwekuphela.
move_hint.suspend: Kumisa kugunyatwa kusebenta ngaphandle kwekwala lifayela. Bantfu babo bayalelwa esangweni kuze kubuyiselwe.

safety_file.rules_hint: Sincumo sakho, hhayi sehlelo. Yonkhe imibandzela lengentasi iyahlolwa futsi ibikwe nome kunjani; letivule tincuma kutsi ngutiphi kuto letala ngempela umcondrakhi esangweni. Tisebenta kuwo wonkhe umcondrakhi, ngobe kutisebentisa ngekungalingani ngiko lokwenta inselelo esangweni iphumelele.

status_hint.COMPLIANT: Konkhe lokufunwako kusefayeleni, kusesikhatsini futsi kwemukelwe.
status_hint.EXPIRING: Akukho lokushodako, kodvwa lokunye kuphelelwa sikhatsi masinyane.
status_hint.NON_COMPLIANT: Lokunye lokufunwako akulungile. Ukhetsile kungakwali kungena ngenca yako.
status_hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Lifayela likumbuketi. Akukho lokushodako — akekho lokavele akemukele.
status_hint.SUSPENDED: Umuntfu umise lelifayela sikhashana. Loko kwendlula konkhe lokubalwe.

rule.MISSING_MEDICAL: Umsebenti udzinga sitifikethi sekufaneleka futsi kute lesikhona
rule.MISSING_METHOD_STATEMENT: Umsebenti udzinga sitatimende sendlela futsi kute lesigciniwe
rule.MISSING_PERMIT: Umsebenti udzinga imvumo yekusebenta futsi kute levuliwe
rule.MISSING_EQUIPMENT_CERTIFICATE: Umsebenti udzinga sitifikethi setisetjentiswa futsi kute lesigciniwe

safety_file.always_blocks: kuhlala kunqabela, futsi akucishwa lapha. Indzawo yemsebenti incuma lisango layo.

activities.title: Imisebenti
activities.subtitle: Umsebenti lowentiwa endzaweni yemsebenti, nekutsi luhlobo ngalunye ludzinga ini kute luvunyelwe.
activities.name: Ligama
activities.code_hint: Loko lokutfunyelwa sifundzi selikhadi, imvume nome i-API. Tinhlamvukulu, kungabi nemikhatsi.
activities.requires_hint: Bufakazi lokufanele umuntfu abe nabo. Sisebenti lesingenabo lobunye balobu siyanqatjelwa lomsebenti ngeligama.
activities.high_risk_hint: Kuwumaka kute kubukwe kabili. Lisango lisebenta ngaloko lomsebenti lokudzingako, hhayi ngaloku.
activities.permit_hint: Imvume kufanele ivulwe ngaphambi kwekutsi lomsebenti ucale.
activities.retire_body: Angeke usaniketwa. Timvume netehlakalo tekungena lesetibhaliwe ngawo tihlala tifundzeka, futsi likhodi lingasetjentiswa futsi ngemuva kwesikhatsi.
activities.empty_body: Kuze kube ngumsebenti utsi udzingani, lisango lelibutwa kutsi “ingabe lomuntfu angasebenta etulu” alinalutfo langaluhlola futsi lidlulisa wonkhe umuntfu. Cala eluhlwini lwaseNingizimu Afrika loletako bese ushintja loko ngamunye akudzingako.
activities.unstaffed: Imisebenti lengu-{n} lekungekho muntfu endzaweni lofanelekako kuyo njengamanje. Nome tifiketi kufanele tilandzelwe, nome sidzingo asilungile.
activities.advisory_body: Umuntfu longenabo bufakazi lobudzingekako uyadluliswa futsi ligebe libhalwe phansi. Vula u-“Likhono lelingekho lemsebenti” emitsetfweni yekuvimba bocontraki kute kunqatjwe esikhundleni saloko.

attendance.title: Endzaweni yemsebenti
attendance.subtitle: Ngubani lolapha nyalo, ngubani longenile waphuma, nalongazange aphume ngekusemtsetfweni.
attendance.long_stays_hint: Bantfu labangu-{n} sebalapha sikhatsi lesingetulu kwemahora langu-{hours}. Lishifu lasebusuku nalo libukeka njalo — kodvwa nendzawo lapho kungekho muntfu lophumako ngekusemtsetfweni.
attendance.when_hint: Yishiye ingenalutfo kute kube nyalo. Sikhatsi lesendlulile siyemukelwa, kute kubhalwe luhla lweliphepha; lesitako asemukelwa.
attendance.manual_note: Kubhalwa njengalokufakwe ngesandla, kute kuhlolwa kukwati kukwehlukanisa nekuskena. Sifundzi lesingasebenti akusona sizatfu sekushiya umuntfu eluhlwini.

overrides.title: Kungena kwesikhashana
overrides.subtitle: Ngubani lodluliselwe esangweni langafanele adlule kulo, nangelilungelo lebani.
overrides.explainer: Kweca kuvumela umuntfu lofayela lakhe lingekho kuhleleko. Kwentelwe kutsi kube melula kukunika — umcontraki lonemsebenti longenandlela yekungena ngiyo indlela bantfu labangena ngayo ngeligama lamakhabunyane — futsi kuphephile ngobe konkhe kubhalwe lapha nesizatfu sako, umvumi wako nekuphela kwako. Akukho lokungasebenta sikhatsi lesingetulu kwemalanga langu-{days}.
overrides.grant_warning: Loku kungenisa endzaweni yemsebenti umuntfu lobetawunqatjelwa. Kubhalwa ngeligama lakho, nangeligama lemvumi lomsho.
overrides.ending_soon_hint: Kweca lokungu-{n} kuphela emalangeni lamabili. Kuvuseleleni nome kuyekeni kuphelelwe — kodvwa ncumani, kunekutsi nikutfole esangweni.
overrides.reason_hint: Loko lotakusebentisa umuntfu lokubuyeketa etinyangeni letisitfupha. Lokungenani tinhlamvu letilishumi.
overrides.conditions_hint: Loko lokufanele bakwente ngesikhatsi kusebenta. Kuphrintwa esincumweni selisango nangabe likhadi labo liskenwa.
overrides.starts_hint: Yishiye ingenalutfo kute kucale nyalo. Kweca kwekuvalwa kwemisebenti kungahlelwa lilanga ngaphambili.
overrides.ends_hint: Kuyadzingeka, futsi lokungenani emalanga langu-{days} latako. Kutivalela kona.
overrides.site_hint: Yishiye ingenalutfo kuto tonkhe tindzawo. Kukunciphisa yindlela lephephe kakhulu.
overrides.approver_hint: Umuntfu lokugunyatile, nangabe kungesiwe wena. Yishiye ingenalutfo futsi kubhalwe ngeligama lakho.
overrides.revoke_body: Lisango libuyela lapho bekukhona, ngekushesha. Nome ngubani lotsembele kuloku kute angene endzaweni kusasa utawunqatjelwa.

portal.title: Kuhambisana kwakho kwetekuphepha
portal.subtitle: Loko {host} lakudzingako kuwe ngaphambi kwekutsi bantfu bakho basebente etindzaweni tabo.
portal.not_a_contractor_body: Awukho eluhlwini lwebocontraki balelikhasimende, ngako atikho tidzingo tekuphepha nge-akhawunti yakho. Nangabe bantfu bakho basebenta etindzaweni tabo, bacele kutsi bakufake.
portal.score_explained: Liphuzu linye ngelidokhumente ngalinye, lifayela lakho lekuphepha, nekwetfulwa kwemuntfu ngamunye.
portal.nothing_outstanding: Akukho lokusasele. Usemuva nato tonkhe tidzingo.
portal.no_workers: Akekho kubantfu bakho loseluhlwini lwalelikhasimende njengamanje.
portal.review_note: Nome ngabe yini loyitfumelako iyabuyeketwa ngaphambi kwekutsi ibalwe. Itawubonakala ilindzile kubuyeketwa kuze bayemukele, ungetsembeli kuyo esangweni ngaphambi kwaloko.
portal.file_hint: I-PDF, sitfombe nome lidokhumente le-Word, kufika ku-20 MB.
portal.upload_done: Kutfunyelwe. Batawukubuyeketa futsi kutawubalwa nangabe sekwemukelwe.

notices.title: Tatiso tebocontraki
notices.subtitle: Loko lesistimu lesikutjela bocontraki bakho, lapho kuya khona, naloko lokuhambe ngempela.
notices.channels_hint: I-imeyili lebhalisiwe yenkampani lencane ivamise kuba yemcwaningimabhuku, lehlolwa kanye ngeliviki. Inombolo kulirekhodi lelifanako ivamise kuba yemphatsi wendzawo.
notices.what_we_send_hint: Tonkhe tatiso lesistimu lesitetfumela kucontraki, naloko lokutibangelako.
notices.unreachable_body: Abanalo likheli etindleleni lotikhetsile, ngako akukho kuletatiso lesibafinyelelako. Akukho lokuphambanako — abatjelwa nje, kuze kube khona lonqatjelwako esangweni.

when.safety_file_rejected: Ngaso leso sikhatsi lenciwa, nesizatfu semhloli
when.blocked: Ngaso leso sikhatsi lisango livalwa, netizatfu
when.worker_blocked: Nangabe umuntfu anciwa ngempela, hhayi emjikelweni wekucaphela
when.induction_required: Onkhe emaviki, njengeluhla lolunye esikhundleni semlayeto ngamunye
when.competency_expiring: Kusukela emalangeni langu-30 ngaphambili, nakanye ngemuva kwekuphela

schemes.title: Tinhlelo tekulandzela imitsetfo nemasango emisebenti
schemes.subtitle: Tinhlelo inhlangano yakho lesebenta ngaphansi kwato (GLOBALG.A.P., SIZA, i-organic, ikhodi yelikhasimende), letemukelwa endzaweni ngayinye kurejista yemtsetfo — kanye nekutsi ngukuphi kuhlola lokufanele kuphumelele ngaphambi kwekutsi luhlobo lwemsebenti lucale.
schemes.name: Ligama
schemes.gates_hint: Umsebenti angeke ucale kuze kuhlola, lokwentelwe lowo msebenti, kuphumelele.

no_company.title: Ayikho inkhampani lesebentako
no_company.body: Idatha yekuphatfwa kwekutsenga ngeyenkhampani. Khetsa inkhampani lofuna kusebenta kuyo.
no_company.body_self_hosted: Ayikho inkampani lesetiwe kuloku kufaka okwamanje. Emarekhodi lapha angawenkampani, ngako dala yinye ngaphansi kwetilungiselelo ngaphambi kwekusebentisa imojuli.

common.title: Sihloko
common.name: Ligama
common.comment_optional: Akuphocelekile, kodvwa kuyamsita lowo lotawukufundza ngemuva.
common.form_errors: Sicela ulungise tinkinga letingu-{n} ngaphambi kwekuchubeka:

new_review.title: Kubuketwa lokusha kwelithenda
new_review.subtitle: Cala kuhlola kusuka eluhlelweni nobe kuyodvwa

documents.title: Emadokhumende
documents.subtitle: Luhlu lunye, lolunamatsiselwe nomakuphi lapho lusebenta khona

analytics.title: Kuhlatiya kwekutsenga
analytics.subtitle: Kutsi imojuli yonkhe isebenta njani, hhayi nje kutsi isebentise malini

dashboard.title: Kubusa kwekutsenga
dashboard.subtitle: Kuhlela, emathenda, kuphambuka nekulandzela endzaweni yinye
dashboard.pipeline_empty: Akukho kutsenga lokusebentako kuze kube nyalo.

planning.title: Emaphulani ekutsenga
planning.subtitle: Tidzingo tekutsenga temnyaka tenhlangano
planning.new_plan_hint: Liphulani lihlanganisa tidzingo temnyaka wetimali welitiko linye nobe iphrojekthi yinye.
planning.create_plan_hint: Liphulani licala njengekwakhiwa. Ngeta tidzingo ngaphambi kwekulitfumela kutobuketwa.
planning.empty: Akukho maphulani ekutsenga kuze kube nyalo.
planning.no_lines: Akukho tidzingo letibhaliwe kulophulani kuze kube nyalo.
planning.cancel_hint: Kukhansela kukhulula nobe ngusiphi sabelomali lesibanjelwe imigca yalophulani.
planning.no_budget_module: Kuphatfwa kweSabelomali akufakwanga, ngako akukho sabelomali lesingahlanganiswa. Liphulani liyasebenta ngaphandle kwaso.
planning.no_budget_position: Akukho sabelomali lesihlanganisiwe, nobe Kuphatfwa kweSabelomali akufakwanga, ngako simo setimali asikwati kukhonjiswa.
planning.delayed_subtitle: Sekwendlulile lusuku lwelithenda nobe lwekuniketa futsi akukaniketwa
planning.upcoming_empty: Akukho lutfo loludzingekako emalangeni langu-60 latako.

tenders.title: Kubuketwa kwemathenda
tenders.subtitle: Kucala, kuhlola, kulungisa nesincomo sekuniketa
tenders.initiate_hint: Kubuketwa kwelithenda kunelikomiti lako, timiso, ticelo nesincomo.
tenders.create_review_hint: Timiso nelikomiti tihlelwa ngemuva, ngaphambi kwekutsi kuhlola kuvulwe.
tenders.empty: Akukho kubuketwa kwemathenda kuze kube nyalo.
tenders.plan_line_hint: Kukhetsa umgca weluhlelo kutsatsa imininingwane yawo.

methodologies.WEIGHTED_hint: Sonkhe simiso silinganiswa sibe liphuzu linye
methodologies.TWO_ENVELOPE_hint: Lisango lebuchwephesha kucala, linani livulwe kuphela kulabo labaphumelele

tenders.weights_must_total: Sisindvo selinani nesekukhetsa kumele sibe ngu-100; singu-{total}.
tenders.no_committees: Akukho makomiti lasebentako kuze kube nyalo — yenta linye ngaphambi kwekutsi kuhlola kuvulwe.
tenders.approval_level_hint: Umbhalo lokhululekile: lizinga lemandla leludzingwa nguloku kuniketa.
tenders.frozen_explainer: Timiso tavalwa nga-{at}, ngesikhatsi kuhlola kuvulwa. Lushintjo nyalo ludzinga sicelo sekushintja timiso lesivunyiwe.
tenders.no_criteria: Akukho timiso letihleliwe kuze kube nyalo.
tenders.no_evaluators: Akukho bahloli labakhetsiwe. Khetsa likomiti kucala.
tenders.coi_outstanding_body: Kuhlola akukwati kuvulwa lize lonkhe lilunga lelivotako limemetele futsi nobe ngukuphi kungcubutana lokumemetelwe kucatululwe.
tenders.no_recommendation: Akukho sincomo lesentiwe. Vuma emaphuzu ekulungiseni kucala.
tenders.recommended_supplier_hint: Ngekwemvelo ngusicelo lesiphakeme; shintja uma likomiti lincoma ngalenye indlela.
tenders.submitted_at_hint: Sicelo lesemukelwe ngemuva kwekuvalwa siphawulwa njengalesephuti.
tenders.preference_framework_hint: Lugcwalisa kwehlukaniswa kwelinani nekukhetsa lokumiswe ngumtsetfo.
tenders.no_framework_for_jurisdiction: Alukho luhlaka lolulungiselelwe lesi sifundza kuze kube nyalo.
tenders.framework_unverified_warning: I-{name} ayikaciniseki ngenchubomgomo yakho yekutsenga leyemukelwe. Hlola emaphuzu ngaphambi kwekuniketa ngawo.
tenders.unconvertible_body: Alikho lizinga lekushintjanisa lelifakiwe la-{currencies} lokucatsaniswa na-{target}. Faka lizinga ku-Finance, ngaphandle kwaloko kuniketa emaphuzu ngeke kukwati kuhlela leticelo.

evaluations.title: Kuhlola kwami
evaluations.subtitle: Emathenda lokhetselwe kuwaniketa emaphuzu
evaluations.none_hint: Utawubona emathenda lapha nawusukhetselwe likomiti lekuhlola.
evaluations.declare_first: Cedza simemetelo sakho sekungcubutana kwetintsandvo ngaphambi kwekuniketa emaphuzu.
evaluations.conflict_blocked: Umemetele kungcubutana. Kuniketa emaphuzu kumisiwe kuze umlawuli akucatulule.
evaluations.declaration_intro: Ngaphambi kwekuniketa emaphuzu, memetela kutsi unayo yini intsandvo kulomunye lofake sicelo kulelithenda.
evaluations.conflict_pending: Kungcubutana lokumemetele kusemlawulini. Awukwati kuniketa emaphuzu kuze kucatululwe.
evaluations.price_hidden: Loku kuhlola kwemavulophu lamabili, ngako emanani eticelo ahlala avaliwe kuze sigaba sebuchwephesha sicedvwe.
evaluations.locked_body: Kutfunyelwe nga-{date}. Loku kuguculo {revision}. Kulungisa kudzinga kuvulwa lokugunyatiwe, lokugcina emaphuzu ekucala.
evaluations.submit_hint: Nawusutfumele emaphuzu akho ayakhiywa futsi abalwa eliphuzwini lelikomiti.
evaluations.confirm_submit_body: Liphuzu lakho lelilinganisiwe ngu-{score}. Ngemuva kwekutfumela, lushintjo ludzinga kuvulwa lokugunyatiwe.

moderation.title: Kulungisa
moderation.subtitle: Catsanisa bahloli, catulula umehluko, uvume emaphuzu ekugcina
moderation.scores_approved: Emaphuzu ekugcina elikomiti avunyiwe. Sincomo nyalo singentiwa.
moderation.open_items: Tintfo letingu-{n} tisavuliwe. Ticatulule ngaphambi kwekuvuma emaphuzu ekugcina.
moderation.variance_hint: Timiso lapho bahloli behluka ngetulu kwe-{pct}% yelinani leliphakeme tiphawulwa ngekwemvelo.
moderation.no_submissions: Akukho kuhlola lokutfunyelwe lokungacatsaniswa kuze kube nyalo.
moderation.reevaluate_warning: Loku kuvula futsi emaphuzu latfunyelwe emhloli. Emaphuzu ekucala ayagcinwa.

committees.title: Emakomiti ekuhlola
committees.subtitle: Emakomiti lamile, emalunga awo nekukhetfwa
committees.type_hint: Sibonelo kuhlola sicelo nobe kwehlulela sicelo.
committees.no_members: Akukho malunga lakhetsiwe kuze kube nyalo.
committees.external_hint: Umuntfu longenayo i-akhawunti kulenkhundla, lokhetfwe ngaphandle kwenhlangano.
committees.needs_quorum: Linemalunga lavotako langu-{have} futsi ikhoramu yalo ngu-{need}.
committees.no_tenders: Lelikomiti alikakhetselwa lithenda kuze kube nyalo.

deviations.title: Kuphambuka
deviations.subtitle: Ticelo tekuphambuka endleleni lejwayelekile yekutsenga
deviations.new_hint: Bhala lokungako nyalo — kuhlolwa kwekulandzela kucala nawutfumela, hhayi nawugcina.
deviations.motivation_hint: Ngiko lokufundvwa kucala ngumhloli-tincwadzi. Chaza lokwentekile nekutsi kungani indlela lejwayelekile ingasetjentiswanga.
deviations.draft_notice: Kugcina kugcina loku njengalokwakhiwako. Imitsetfo yekulandzela isebenta nawukutfumela kutovunywa.
deviations.no_rules: Inhlangano yakho ayikahleli mitsetfo yekulandzela yekuphambuka.
deviations.submit_body: Imitsetfo yekulandzela isebenta nyalo, futsi liketane lekuvuma likhetfwa elinaneni, elitikweni, eluhlotjeni nasengotini yaloku kuphambuka.
deviations.acceptance_reason_hint: Kubhalwa kulokuhlola futsi kubonwa ngiwo wonkhe lovumako.

fields.reason_hint: Ngemusho munye nobe lemibili, yini lokwenta loku kudzingeke.
fields.business_justification_hint: Kungani loku kulungile kutsi inhlangano ikwente.
fields.risk_assessment_hint: Yini lengahamba kabi, nekutsi yini lekwehlisako.
fields.proposed_alternative_hint: Yini lebekucatjangwa esikhundleni saloko, nekutsi kungani ingasetjentiswanga.

records.title: Emarekhodi ekutsenga
records.subtitle: Konkhe kutsenga, kusuka ekucaleni kuya ekugcineni, kurekhodi linye
records.empty: Akukho marekhodi ekutsenga kuze kube nyalo.
records.no_timeline: Akukho kushintja kwetigaba lokubhaliwe kuze kube nyalo.
records.no_procurement: Akukho lutfo lolusuka esigabeni sesicelo nobe sekuhlela loluhlanganisiwe.
records.no_supplier: Akukho mgcugcuteli lohlanganisiwe kuze kube nyalo.
records.no_contract: Akukho sivumelwane lesihlanganisiwe kuze kube nyalo.
records.no_tender: Akukho kubuketwa kwelithenda lokuphakanyisiwe kuloku kutsenga.

audit.subtitle: Sonkhe sento, ngubani lositentile, nini, nekutsi yini leshintjile

settings.fy_start_hint: Umisa kutsi kutsenga kubikwa kumuphi umnyaka.
settings.budget_warning_hint: Cwayisa nangabe liphulani lifika kulesi sabelo sesabelomali lesikhona.
settings.variance_hint: Phawula simiso nangabe bahloli behluka ngetulu kwalesi sabelo selinani leliphakeme.
settings.workload_order: Kumele ibe ngetulu kwemkhawulo wemtfwalo lophakeme.
settings.escalation_days_hint: Sikhatsi kuvunywa lokungahlala ngaso ngaphambi kwekutsi baphatsi batjelwe.
settings.require_coi_hint: Kuhlola akukwati kuvulwa lize lonkhe lilunga lelivotako limemetele.
settings.allow_reopen_hint: Kuvulwa futsi kubhala sizatfu saso futsi kugcina emaphuzu ekucala.
settings.block_over_budget_hint: Kucishiwe ngekwemvelo: letinye tinhlangano tihlela ngamabomu ngetulu.

Emadokhumende ladzingekako, emazinga ekuvuma, imikhawulo, tindzawo letiphocelelekile, timemetelo, imikhawulo yesikhatsi nekukhuphulwa konkhe kuhlelwa njengemitsetfo, kuze luhlelo lunye lusebentele tinhlaka letehlukene.
settings.no_rule_sets: Akukho masethi emitsetfo lahleliwe. Kutfumela kutawuphumelela kungekho mitsetfo lehloliwe.
settings.no_rules_in_set: Akukho mitsetfo kulelisethi kuze kube nyalo.
settings.severity_hint: Kwehluleka kuvimbela kutfumela; sicwayiso siyaphawula kuphela.
settings.framework_hint: Ngemarekhodi akho kuphela — akukho lutfo lolutsatsa sincumo kuloku.
settings.message_hint: Emagama akho atsatsa indzawo yalawo eluhlelo.

settings.chains_explainer: Liketane lichaza kutsi lisebenta nini. Kufanana lokucondzile kuyaphumelela, kuze sicelo lesifanako sihambe ngendlela lefanako njalo.
settings.is_default: Sebentisa nangabe kungekho lelinye liketane lelifanako
settings.is_default_hint: Linye lelisisekelo ngesihloko ngasinye lenta sonkhe sicelo sibe nendlela.
settings.retire_chain_body: Liketane liyekela kutfumela ticelo letinsha. Tincumo lesetitsatsiwe ngalo tigcina irekhodi lato, futsi akukho lokusavunyiwe lokushintjako.
settings.code_locked_hint: Ikhodi ikhomba leliketane futsi ayikwati kushintjwa.
settings.steps_hint: Kuvunywa kwenteka ngalendlela. Shintja luhlelo ngemicibisholo.
settings.single_approver_hint: Umuntfu munye lobaliwe usayina lesi sinyatselo.
settings.preference_explainer: Tinhlaka tekukhetsa tincuma kutsi umnikeli utfola malini ngaphandle kwelinani. Ifomula yelinani imiswe ngumtsetfo; emaphuzu abekwa yinchubomgomo yakho, ngako lithebula lelifakiwe lisicalo kuze uliciniseke.
settings.fx_basis_hint: Ngulukuphi lusuku lelizinga lekushintjanisa lelicatsanisa ticelo ngetimali letehlukene.
settings.fx_basis_submission_warning: Kugucula sicelo ngasinye ngelusuku lwaso lwekutfumela kusho kutsi ticelo letimbili letifanako tingaba netikhundla letehlukene ngenca nje yekufika ngemalanga lehlukene.
settings.fx_rate_type_hint: Kufanana neluhlobo lelugcinwe ku-Finance, ngalokujwayelekile yi-spot.
settings.framework_no_bands: Akukho emabhendi labekiwe. Akukho lokutawuniketwa ngaphansi kwalolu hlaka kuze kubekwe.
settings.retire_framework_body: Luhlaka luyekela kuniketwa kumathenda lamasha. Emathenda lasaniketwe emaphuzu ngalo agcina irekhodi lawo.
settings.basis_hint: Emaphuzu aniketa umklomelo; umkhawulo uniketa inzuzo yelinani esikhundleni saloko.
settings.framework_notes_hint: Loku kusekelwe kuphi, nanobe yini lesadzinga kucinisekiswa.
settings.bands_hint: Kuhlolwa ngekulandzelana; libhendi lekucala lomnikeli lelifanana nalo nguleso lelisebentako.
settings.confirm_verified: Ngiyaciniseka kutsi letibalo tihambisana nenchubomgomo yetfu yekutsenga leyemukelwe
settings.confirm_verified_hint: Kubhalwa ngaphansi kweligama lakho. Kuhlela tibalo ngemuva kususa loku kuze kuniketwe futsi.
settings.confirm_verified_note: Loluhlaka lutawuphawulwa njengalolucinisekisiwe, ngeligama lakho, nawugcina.

portal.local_content: Lesi sicelo sihlangabetana nesidzingo salokucuketfwe kwendzawo
portal.confirm: Ngiyaciniseka kutsi lesi sicelo silungile futsi singeniswe egameni lenkhampani lebalwe ngenhla
portal.confirm_hint: Nasesitfunyelwe, sicelo sakho siyavalwa futsi asikwati kushintjwa. Tsintsana nesikhulu sekutsenga nangabe udzinga kusishintja.
portal.closed_warning: Lelithenda selivaliwe. Usengatfumela, kodvwa sicelo sakho sitawubhalwa njengalesephuti futsi kusekomitini kutsi sicatjangelwe yini.
portal.received_body: Sihlala sivaliwe kuze lithenda livalwe, bese sivulwa kanye nato tonkhe letinye ticelo ngetikhulu letimbili.
portal.received_late: Sicelo sakho semukelwe ngemuva kwesikhatsi sekuvala
portal.received_late_body: Sibhalwe njengalesephuti. Kutsi sicelo lesephuti singacatjangelwa yini kuncunywa likomiti ngekwemitsetfo yalo.
portal.receipt_hint: Sigcine. Sikhomba sicelo sakho ngaphandle kwekusembula.
portal.footer: Kutfunyelwe nge-Mkhaya Hub. Lelikhonkco ngelakho wedvwa — ungalabelani nalabanye.

intake.explainer: Bagcugcuteli labamenyiwe batfumela ngesixhumanisi sabo. Ticelo tihlala tivaliwe kuze lithenda livalwe, bese tonkhe tivulwa ndzawonye ngetikhulu letimbili.
intake.invite_hint: Kwenta sixhumanisi lesiyimfihlo salomgcugcuteli. Msitfumele — nguyo yodvwa indlela yakhe yekungena.
intake.none_invited: Bakhona bagcugcuteli labamenyiwe kuze kube nyalo.
intake.link_once: Kukhonjiswa kanye. Sikopishe nyalo — angeke sibonakale futsi.
intake.withdraw_body: Sicelo lesivaliwe siyasuswa kuze lomgcugcuteli akwati kutfumela futsi. Kokubili kuhoxiswa nesicelo lesisha kuhlala emkhondvweni wekuhlola.
intake.opening_explainer: Tonkhe ticelo letivaliwe tivulwa kanyekanye, nguwe nemfakazi. Kuvula kwenteka kanye futsi angeke kubuyiselwe emuva.
intake.open_warning: Sonkhe sicelo lesivaliwe siyafundzeka kulomzuzu, futsi angeke kubuyiselwe emuva. Chubeka kuphela nangabe umfakazi wakho akhona.
intake.witness_hint: Umuntfu wesibili, lokhona ekuvulweni, lobhalwe ethendeni.
