analytics.pipeline_hint: Lapho umsebenti uwela khona emkhatsini wekuhlela nekuvala.
analytics.competition_hint: Iphethini yemathenda lanesicelo sinye siphawu lesicacile kulemininingwane.
analytics.bottlenecks_hint: Ngesinyatselo, ngobe liketane liyephuta nangabe sihlalo sinye siyephuta.
analytics.awards_hint: Ngubani lowawina kuniketwa lokungu-{n}, nangaphansi kwemiphi imitsetfo.
analytics.trend_hint: Sewonkhe sitjela lapho ukhona; luchungechunge lutjela lapho uya khona.

budgets_approvals.title: Kugunyatwa kwetabelomali
budgets_approvals.subtitle: Tincumo letikulindzele, naloko lokulindzele wena.
budgets_approvals.reject_reason_hint: Umuntfu okuthumele uyakubona loku, ngakho sho kutsi yini okumele ishintshe.
budgets_approvals.confirm_approve_body: Kugunyata “{label}” kuhambisa imali yangempela. Loku kuqoshwa egameni lakho.
budgets_approvals.covering_notice: Okunye kwaloku kulapha ngoba umela kugunyata kuka-{names}.
budgets_approvals.given_sub: Ubani ophethe kugunyatwa kwakho kwetabelomali ngesikhathi ungekho. Bengezwa njengomgunyazi — usengaquma nome yini wena.
budgets_approvals.received_sub: Kugunyata kukabani ongakunquma, kuze kube nini.
budgets_approvals.delegate_sub: Omunye umuntfu angaquma kugunyatwa kwakho kwetabelomali sikhatsi esithile.
budgets_approvals.delegate_notice: Ukumela kungeza umgunyati kunokudlulisa ilungelo, ngakho usengaquma nome yini wena. Ukwehlukanisa imisebenzi kusasebenza: akekho ongagunyaza lokho okutfunyelwe nguwe.
budgets_approvals.no_cover: Akekho okucele ukuba umele kugunyata kwakhe.
budgets_approvals.confirm_end_delegation_body: {to} akasakwazi ukunquma kugunyata kwakho. Tincumo asezenzile azishintshi.
budgets_approvals.hint_from_user: Shiya kunguwe ngaphandle uma uhlelela omunye umuntfu.
budgets_approvals.hint_ends_on: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kungabi nasiphelo, isb. isikhundla esingenamuntu.

budgets_approval_setup.title: Kudluliswa kwekugunyatwa kwetabelomali
budgets_approval_setup.subtitle: Ubani osayina ini, kule nkampani.
budgets_approval_setup.default_notice: Ngaphandle kokudluliswa okuhleliwe, tonkhe tincumo zesabelomali zisema emgqeni — futhi nome ubani ongagunyaza tabelomali angakunquma. Hlela indlela lapha uma ufuna ileli elithile, umtsetfo wamasiginesha amabili, nome umkhawulo lapho ngezansi kwawo kungadluliswa lutho.
budgets_approval_setup.no_hr_notice: Ayikho imojula ye-HR efakiwe, ngakho isinyathelo esibekwe ku-“imenenja yotfumelayo” asikwazi ukwaneliswa muntu. Sebenzisa indima nome umuntfu oqanjiwe kunalokho.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_adjustment: Ukunyusa, ukwehlisa nome ukudlulisa kwesabelo esikhona.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_reservation: Izimali ezibanjelwe sabelomali ngaphambi kokuba kube ne-oda lokuthenga.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_body: “{name}” ngeke isadlulisa lutho. Akukho okuvele kunqunyiwe okushintshayo.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_pending: “{name}” isenezinqumo ezingu-{count} emgqeni. Lezo zigcina ileli lazo nomlando wazo; akukho okusha okuzodluliswa ngayo.
budgets_approval_setup.steps_hint: Likhwelwa ngokulandelana. Qamba bantfu ngomthetho lapho ungakwazi — indima iyaphila nome umuntfu ehamba.
budgets_approval_setup.allow_self: Vumela umuntfu othumele kutsi agunyaze lesi sinyathelo

budgets_tracking.title: Kulandzelela tabelomali
budgets_tracking.subtitle: Kutsi zimi kanjani tonkhe tabelomali, yini esiyikhathaza, nokuthi yini emisiwe.
budgets_tracking.position_hint: Okuboshiwe kufaka lokho okubekelwe nokukhiyiwe, hhayi kuphela lokho osekukhokhelwe nge-invoyisi.
budgets_tracking.rules_subtitle: Kutsi le nkampani ifuna ukwaziswa nini, nokuthi ifuna ukumiswa nini.
budgets_tracking.block_notice: Umtsetfo oVimbayo kuphela owenqabayo. Uphoqelelwa lapho izimali zibekelwa nome ziboshwa khona, hhayi kuleli khasi kuphela.
budgets_tracking.no_rules: Ayikho imitsetfo nyalo. Tabelomali ezidlulayo zisabikwa.
budgets_tracking.confirm_delete_rule_body: “{name}” uyeka ukubuka. Ticwayiso esezivele ziphakanyisiwe zixazululwa ekuhloleni okulandelayo.
budgets_tracking.ack_hint: Okwenziwayo ngakho. Sicwayiso sihlala sisebenza kuze kuphele isimo.

budgets_insights.analytics_sub: Kutsi imali ibekwe kanjani, iyaphi, nokuthi yini elindele sincumo.
budgets_insights.truncated: Kubonisa imigqa engu-500 yokuqala. Ukuthunyelwa kwe-CSV kunayo yonkhe.

report_sources.budgets: Kuqoshwa lapho sabelomali sidalwa, ku-Tabelomali › Sabelomali Lesisha.
report_sources.ledger: Kususelwa encwadini yamabhuku yokubekelwa, ukubopha nokusetshenziswa kwemali.
report_sources.reservations: Kubhalwa lapho isicelo sokuthenga sigunyazwa, nome kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.commitments: Kubhalwa lapho i-oda lokuthenga likhishwa, nome kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.consumptions: Kubhalwa lapho i-invoyisi nome i-GRN ipositwa, nome kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.adjustments: Kuphakanyiswa esabelweni njengokunyusa, ukwehlisa nome ukudlulisa.
report_sources.overrides: Kuphakanyiswa esabelweni lapho umuntfu ecela ukusebenzisa imali ngaphesheya kwesabelo.
report_sources.approvals: Tonkhe tincumo ezidluliselwe, zisuka emgqeni wokugunyaza.
report_sources.alerts: Kuphakanyiswa ukuhlolwa kwasebusuku ngokwemithetho yezexwayiso yale nkampani.
report_sources.phasing: Kutfwetjulwe kuthebhu yeKuhlukanisa yesabelomali ngasinye: tikhatsi letivaliwe letendlula umkhawulo wemehluko wemnyaka, kanye nesizatfu sato sekungafinyeleli luhlelo.

chart.spend_empty: Ayikho imali eqoshiwe nyalo. Ifika lapho i-invoyisi ipositwa, nome lapho umuntfu eyiqopha esabelweni.
chart.cycle_sub: Amahora amaphakathi kusukela ekutfunyelweni kuya esinqumweni, ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezedlule.

budgets_planning.title: Kulungiselela tabelomali
budgets_planning.subtitle: Dlulisela unyaka, ngenisa owodwa usuka kwispredishithi, uvale lowo osuphelile.
budgets_planning.years_sub: Ukwabiwa ngezikhathi kudinga tikhatsi; unyaka ongenazo awunalo uhlelo lokuqhathanisa nokusetshenziswa kwemali.
budgets_planning.no_periods_hint: Azikho tikhatsi ezichaziwe. Zakhe Kumasethingi ukuze tabelomali zabiwe ngezikhathi.
budgets_planning.confirm_close_body: Tabelomali ku-{name} zivalwa kanye nawo. Ukubopha osekwenziwe kusadinga ukukhokhelwa nge-invoyisi.
budgets_planning.mode_allocation_hint: Unyaka olandelayo uqala ngenani lalo nyaka — indawo evamile yokuqala umjikelezo omusha.
budgets_planning.mode_unspent_hint: Unyaka olandelayo uqala ngalokho obekusatholakala. Tabelomali ezingenalutho ziyeqiwa.
budgets_planning.carry_notice: Konke kufika njengoluhlaka. Akukho okusebenzayo kuze kube khona ogunyazayo.
budgets_planning.import_sub: I-CSV, isuka ngqo kwispredishithi umjikelezo oqale kuso.
budgets_planning.import_notice: Imigqa ihlolwa ngamunye. Umugqa ombi ubikwa ngenombolo yomugqa; emihle isangeniswa, njengezinhlaka.
budgets_planning.template_sub: Yona kanye ifayela elifundwa umngenisi, nemigqa emibili yesibonelo egcwalisiwe.
budgets_planning.hint_target_year: Tonkhe tabelomali kufayela zidalwa kulo nyaka.
budgets_planning.hint_file: I-CSV kuphela, kufika ku-5 MB. Londoloza njenge-“CSV UTF-8” ku-Excel.
budgets_planning.how_1: Umugqa wokuqala kumele ube ngowesihloko. Amagama afaniswa ngaphandle kokunaka onobumba abakhulu futhi izikhala ziba ngama-underscore, ngakho “Allocated Amount” no-“allocated_amount” kuyikholomu efanayo.
budgets_planning.how_2: Ukulandelana kwamakholomu akunandaba, futhi amakholomu ongawadingi angashiywa ngokuphelele efayeleni.
budgets_planning.how_3: Umugqa ngamunye uhlolwa wodwa. Umugqa ohlulekayo ubikwa ngenombolo yawo yomugqa efayeleni futhi weqiwe — eminye isangeniswa.
budgets_planning.how_4: Konke kufika njengoluhlaka. Akukho okusebenzayo, futhi akukho okungena emgqeni wokugunyaza kuze kube khona okutfumelayo.
budgets_planning.how_5: Inani umngenisi angalazi — isigaba esibhalwe ngokungeyikho nome uhlobo lokusetshenziswa kwemali — alenzi umugqa uhluleke. Libuyela kokuzenzakalelayo bese libhalwa njengesexwayiso ngemuva.
budgets_planning.how_6: Akukho okuhlungwayo kabili. Ukulayisha ifayela elifanayo kabili kudala tabelomali kabili, ngakho ngenisa ifayela elilungisiwe onyakeni omusha nome qala ususe izinhlaka.
budgets_planning.col_help_name: Igama lesabelomali, isb. “Izinsiza zeHhovisi Eliyinhloko”. Igama elingenalutho lenza umugqa uhluleke.
budgets_planning.col_help_allocated_amount: Inombolo. Izimpawu zemali, izikhala nabahlukanisi bezinkulungwane bayasuswa, ngakho “R 1 850 000,00” no-“1850000” kokubili kuyasebenza. Nome yini engeyona inombolo yenza umugqa uhluleke.
budgets_planning.col_help_expenditure_type: Ibuyela ku-opex uma kungenalutho nome kungaziwa.
budgets_planning.col_help_category: Kumele kufane nelinye lamagama ezigaba angezansi. Igama elingafani lishiya sabelomali singenasigaba futhi liphakamise sicwayiso.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_type: Ibuyela kokujwayelekile uma kungenalutho nome kungaziwa.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_label: Umbhalo okhululekile oqamba umnyango, iphrojekthi nome indawo yezindleko, isb. “Ihhovisi Eliyinhloko”.
budgets_planning.col_help_currency: Ikhodi yezinhlamvu ezintathu njenge-ZAR. Nome yini enye iyaziwa futhi kusebenza okuzenzakalelayo kwenkampani.
budgets_planning.categories_hint: Upelo lufaniswa ngaphandle kokunaka onobumba abakhulu, kodvwa igama kumele libe yilona kanye ngaphandle kwalokho.
budgets_planning.categories_none: Azikho izigaba nyalo. Zengeze ngaphansi kwe-Lungiselela › Amasethingi, nome ushiye ikholomu yesigaba ingenalutho.

supplier_registration.intro: I-{company} ikumemele ukuthi ujoyine uhlu lwayo lwabahlinzeki abavunyiwe. Sicela uqinisekise imininingwane yakho engezansi.
supplier_registration.documents_after: Ungawalayisha esangweni lakho lomhlinzeki uma leli fomu selithunyelwe.

onboarding_bulk.title: Kungenisa ngebunyenti
onboarding_bulk.subtitle: Ngenisa basebenti labasha labanyenti ngasikhatsi sinye nge-spreadsheet
onboarding_bulk.upload_sub: Imigca yentiwa ngayinye, ngako umugca lomubi awulahli lemihle
onboarding_bulk.field_default_template_hint: Sisetjentiswa nangabe umugca ushiya likholomu lesifanekiso lingenalutfo
onboarding_bulk.columns_hint: Emakholomu lanenkhanyeti ayadzingeka. Lamanye angashiywa angenalutfo. Kulandzelana kwemakholomu akubalulekile — afaniswa ngeligama.

document_management.history_help: Konkhe lokwenteke kulelidokhumente, kufaka ekhatsi kutsi ngubani lolivulile.
document_management.sensitivity_help: Kushintja nome ngukuphi kwaloku kubhalwa neligama lakho.
document_management.sensitivity_note_hint: Kungani kuphawulwe — kusita nangabe umuntfu abuta kamuva.
document_management.remove_help: Kugcina kuyabuyiselwa. Kususa kungahlehliswa kuze kube lidokhumente libhujiswe unomphela.
document_management.hold_explainer: Lelidokhumente liphansi kwekubanjwa ngekwemtsetfo. Angeke lisuswe nangabe loko kusendzaweni.

settings_page.title: Tilungiselelo temadokhumente
settings_page.subtitle: Lokungalayishwa lapha, bukhulu bungakanani, nekutsi emadokhumente abitwa njani.
settings_page.max_size_hint: Kusebenta kulifayela ngalinye, hhayi kukonkhe kulayisha.
settings_page.types_help: Luhla lwekuvumela. Nome yini lengekho kulo iyaliwa.
settings_page.blocked_hint: Tisuswa eluhlwini lelivumelekile nome tikhona kulo.
settings_page.never_help: Leti tiyaliwa nome ngabe kulungiselelwe njani. Siphequluli nome iseva ingatisebentisa, futsi lilayibhulali lemadokhumente alinasizatfu sekwemukela lokunye.
settings_page.categories_hint: Kutsi lidokhumente liyini, ngekwehlukile kukutsi lifayiliwe kuphi. Tigaba letakhiwe ngekhatsi tingabitwa kabusha nome tivalwe kodvwa atisuswa — imibiko nemitsetfo yekugcina ibhekisa kuto.
settings_page.category_protected: Tigaba letakhiwe ngekhatsi angeke tisuswe. Kunaloko tivale.
settings_page.expiry_hint: Ecwayisa bantfu ngaphambi kwekutsi lidokhumente liphele. Kushanela kusebenta njalo ekuseni futsi kutsumela sikhumbuto ngasinye kanye.
settings_page.expiry_days_hint: Cindzetela u-enter ngemuva kwelinani ngalinye. U-0 usho ngelusuku lwekuphela ngewalo.
settings_page.expiry_roles_hint: Umnikati welidokhumente uyatiswa njalo. Tindima, hhayi emagama, kuze sikhumbuto silandele nome ngubani lophetse umsebenti.
settings_page.retention_hint: How long documents in this category are kept. Leave the period empty for no schedule — nothing is ever destroyed automatically.
settings_page.retention_note_hint: Shown beside the disposal queue, so a reviewer can see what the rule is for.
settings_page.sharing_warning: With this on, anybody holding a share link can open that document without signing in. Each link still expires, can be revoked, and is recorded.
settings_page.sharing_enabled: Allow documents to be shared outside the organisation
settings_page.share_max_days_hint: The ceiling for any link. Somebody asking for longer gets this.
settings_page.ai_warning: With this on, the contents of a document are sent to the AI provider this platform is configured with, and count against the company’s monthly allowance.
settings_page.ai_enabled: Allow summaries and questions about documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential: Include confidential and legally held documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential_hint: Off by default. These are the documents an organisation is least willing to hand to an outside service.
settings_page.watermark_default_hint: Each share can still be changed individually. A watermark makes a leaked copy traceable; it does not prevent one.
settings_page.auto_delete_warning: With this on, documents a reviewer has approved for disposal are deleted without further confirmation. Deletion here is recoverable — permanent destruction always stays with a person.
settings_page.disposal_grace_days_hint: How long an approval waits before it is acted on, so a mistake can be caught.
settings_page.automation_hint: What this category does on its own once the dates above have passed.
settings_page.archive_after_years_hint: Counted from the same date as the retention period
settings_page.auto_delete: Delete automatically once a disposal is approved
settings_page.auto_delete_hint: Needs the company-wide setting as well. Documents under legal hold are never touched.
settings_page.categories_delete_consequence: Only possible while nothing is filed under it.
settings_page.category_fields_hint: Loko lolu hlobo lwemculu lolukutfwele ngaphandle kwalokujwayelekile. Sivumelwane sidzinga lomunye lombandzakanyekako; irisidi ayidzingi lutfo.
settings_page.category_workflow_hint: Kute "timiso tiya kubemtsetfo" kube yintfo yetimiso kunekukhunjulwa kukulayisha ngakunye.
settings_page.numbering_next_hint: Kubeke kute uchubeke usukela kuspredishithi kunekucala futsi ku-1.
settings_page.numbering_pattern_hint: Tindzawo: {YYYY} {YY} {MM} nange-#### kwekulandzelana. Kushiye kungenalutfo kute usebentise tinombolo tenkhampani.
settings_page.watermark_previews_hint: Kufundvwa kuphela kuvimbela kulayisha kodvwa akwenti lutfo ngesitfombe sesikrini. Luphawu lolusho kutsi ngubani lobekabuka nguko kuphela lokwentako.
settings_page.downloads_days_hint: Sikhatsi umuntfu lagcina ngaso likhophi lalivunyelwe.
settings_page.lock_hours_hint: Emva kwaloku umculu utivula, kuze kungabikho lovinjelwe ngumuntfu losekhefini.

document_management.folder_confidential_hint: Konkhe lokufayiliwe lapha kuphatfwa njengalokuyimfihlo, kufaka ekhatsi emafolda langaphansi.

document_management.folder_delete_confirm: Susa "{name}"? Lifolda nemafolda langaphansi langenalutfo ayasuswa.

document_management.expiry_banner_soon: Emadokhumente langu-{n} aphela emkhatsini wemalanga langu-30.

document_management.comment_required: Sho kutsi kungani, kuze umbhali ati lokumele akushintje.
document_management.approval_workflow_hint: Shiya njengobe kunjalo kusebentisa lolo lolumiselwe lesigaba.
document_management.delegate_explain: Kugunyatwa kwendlulela kubo. Angeke usakhone kukuphendvula.
document_management.templates_subtitle: Emadokhumente lanemininingwane legcwaliswe kusuka kumarekhodi luhlelo loseluvele lunawo.
document_management.template_fields_hint: Cindzetela kunye kukubeka lapho sikhombisi sikhona.
document_management.template_unknown_list: Lawa makhambu akekho futsi atawuphrintwa njengalokubhalwe: {fields}

document_management.signature_fields_hint: Ngelikhasi nangemuntfu. Kubeka ngco elikhasini akukatfolakali.
document_management.holds_subtitle: What is being preserved, and for which matter
document_management.holds_pick_matter: Choose a matter to see what is held under it.
document_management.holds_release_warning: Once the last hold is lifted, this document can be deleted and destroyed again. The record that it was held is kept.
document_management.holds_close_matter_warning: This lifts every hold placed under {reference} — {n} document(s) at once.
document_management.disposal_subtitle: Documents whose retention period has run out
document_management.disposal_nothing_automatic: Nothing here is destroyed automatically. Each document waits for somebody to decide, and approving a disposal is not the same as carrying it out.
document_management.disposal_keep_explained: It stays, and comes up for review again at the end of its next retention period.
document_management.disposal_approve_explained: This records that it may be destroyed. Somebody with the destroy permission still has to carry it out.
document_management.disposal_note_hint: Why this was decided. It is kept with the document’s history.
document_management.disposal_queue_empty: Nothing has come due for review.
document_management.sharing_off: External sharing is switched off for this company.
document_management.share_none: This document has not been shared outside.
document_management.share_link_once: Copy this link now — it is not shown again.
document_management.share_warning: Anyone holding this link can open the document without signing in.
document_management.share_recipient_hint: Not a restriction — it records who it was meant for.
document_management.share_password_hint: Optional. Send it separately from the link.
document_management.share_allow_download_hint: Off means the document can be read but not saved.
document_management.shared_locked_hint: Enter the password you were given to open it.
document_management.ai_summary_caveat: Written by a model from the document’s text. Check anything you intend to act on against the document itself.
document_management.ai_question_hint: Answered only from this document’s text.
document_management.ai_unavailable: The assistant is not available for this document.
document_management.ai_disabled: The assistant is switched off for this company.
document_management.ai_confidential_excluded: This document is confidential or under legal hold, and this company has not allowed those to be sent to the assistant.
document_management.ai_no_text: There is no readable text in this document — it may be a scan that needs OCR.
document_management.ai_quota: This company’s monthly AI allowance is used up.
document_management.ai_failed: The assistant could not be reached. Try again shortly.
document_management.share_internal_none: Not shared with anybody beyond the usual folder access.
document_management.share_internal_hint: This opens the document to somebody who cannot otherwise see it. It does not change who can see anything else.
document_management.share_internal_expiry_hint: Leave empty to keep it open
document_management.activity_subtitle: Every recorded action on documents you can see
document_management.activity_recent: The last {days} days. Use the dates to look further back.
document_management.activity_document_gone: a document that has since been removed
document_management.extraction_no_text_layer: This looks like a scan. Its contents cannot be searched or summarised until it is put through OCR.
document_management.extraction_ocr_unavailable: This document needs OCR to be readable, and no OCR engine is installed on this server.
document_management.extraction_failed: The contents of this document could not be read. Searching will not find anything inside it.
document_management.ai_extract_fields: Read the details off this document
document_management.ai_fields_hint: Read by a model from the document text. Tick what is right — nothing is saved until you do.
document_management.ai_no_fields: Nothing could be read off this document.
document_management.ai_nothing_accepted: Tick at least one detail first.
document_management.ai_no_document: That document is no longer available.
document_management.share_watermark_hint: Stamps the recipient and date across each page. Not a security control — it makes a leaked copy traceable.
document_management.record_upload_hint: It is filed in the document library and linked to this record, so it can be found either way.
document_management.record_title_hint: Leave empty to use the file name
document_management.record_expiry_hint: Set this and the system will chase the renewal
document_management.record_none: Nothing filed against this record yet.
document_management.dashboard_subtitle: What needs attention, and what the repository holds
document_management.dashboard_nothing_expiring: Nothing is expiring in the next 30 days.
document_management.storage_subtitle: What is using space, and which files to look at first
document_management.dashboard_empty_hint: Once documents are uploaded, this page shows what is expiring, what is waiting on you, and what the repository holds.
document_management.view_shared-with-me_hint: Documents somebody gave you access to
document_management.view_archived_hint: Out of the way but still searchable, and restorable at any time
document_management.view_confidential_hint: Documents marked confidential, or filed in a confidential folder
document_management.view_legal-hold_hint: Being preserved for a matter. None of these can be deleted
document_management.view_expiring_hint: Due for renewal within the next 90 days
document_management.view_expired_hint: Past their expiry date and still on file
document_management.view_awaiting-approval_hint: Submitted and waiting for somebody to decide
document_management.view_awaiting-signature_hint: Sent out and not yet signed by everyone
document_management.view_unreadable_hint: Scans and files whose contents could not be read
document_management.access_title: You do not have access to this document
document_management.access_hint: Somebody sent you this link, but it has not been shared with you. You can ask for access.
document_management.access_reason_hint: Optional, but it is what the person deciding will read.
document_management.access_already: Your request has been sent. You will be able to open the document once somebody approves it.
document_management.access_requests_subtitle: People asking to be let in to a document or folder
document_management.access_folder_note: This grants the documents filed in that folder now. Anything added later is a new decision.
document_management.recycle_subtitle: Deleted documents stay here for {days} days and can be put back at any time
document_management.recycle_purge_warning: This destroys the document and every version of it. The record that it existed and was destroyed is kept, but the file cannot be recovered.
document_management.recycle_empty_warning: Everything removed here is destroyed permanently.
document_management.recycle_empty_counts: {purgeable} document(s) are past their window. {held} under legal hold will not be touched.
document_management.recycle_empty_everything: Include documents still within their window
document_management.recycle_empty_everything_hint: Off by default. Emptying normally means everything past its recovery window, not what somebody deleted this morning.
document_management.groups_subtitle: Give access to a set of people rather than to a list of names
document_management.groups_expires_hint: Optional. When it ends, every access it gave ends with it.
document_management.groups_member_expires_hint: Optional — for a secondee or somebody covering leave.
document_management.groups_no_folders: No folders given to this group yet.
document_management.groups_folders_hint: One set of permissions across all the folders you choose. That is what makes this one decision rather than several.
document_management.groups_access_expires_hint: Optional. Access with a date on it does not have to be remembered and revoked.
document_management.downloads_read_only_hint: Lomculu ungafundvwa lapha kodvwa angeke ulayishwe.
document_management.downloads_read_only_folder: Lelifayela lelokufundvwa kuphela, ngako emakhophi alako lokugcinwe kulo akaphumi.
document_management.access_map_subtitle: Ngubani longafinyelela kuni, ngani, nalokuphelako ngekwako.
document_management.access_map_ending_hint: Inhloso yekufinyelela kwesikhashana kutsi kute lokufanele akukhumbule. Kodvwa kusafanele kube khona longakubona.
document_management.access_map_no_folders: Akakwati kuvula nome ngabe liphi lifayela.
document_management.access_map_checked_out_hint: Kunemuntfu losebenta kuyo. Kute lomunye longalayisha inguculo lensha kuze acedze.
document_management.requests_what_hint: Sho intfo, hhayi lifayela — "Likhophi le-ID lelicinisekisiwe" kunekutsi "skena".
document_management.checklists_no_templates: Kute tinhlobo temaphakethe letisetiwe. Luhlobo lwephakethe luhlu njengemtsetfo — "liphakethe lesisebenti lesisha imiculu lesikhombisa".
document_management.checklists_no_folder: Kute lifayela lelikhetsiwe, ngako kute lokutawutimaka.
document_management.checklists_expects_anything: Kute lokusetiwe kufanana — loku kumakwa ngesandla
document_management.checklists_chase_hint: Yonkhe intfo lesalindzile iba sicelo, ngesento sinye. Kucela ngayinye kulapho leyekugcina ikhohlakala khona.
document_management.checklists_subject_hint: Umuntfu, umhlinteki, litendela — nome ngabe yini leliphakethe lelimayelana nayo.
document_management.checklists_folder_hint: Lapho imiculu ihlala khona. Tintfo tiyatimaka njengobe imiculu lefanako igcinwa lapha.
document_management.checklists_template_hint: Bita liphakethe, hhayi lelicala — "Liphakethe lesisebenti lesisha", hhayi "Thandi".
document_management.checklists_category_hint: Intfo lenesigaba iyatimaka nangabe umculu walesosigaba ugcinwa efayeleni. Lengenaso ingamakwa ngesandla kuphela.
document_management.superseded_banner: Lona akusiwo umculu losebentako. Watjintjwa nge-{date}.
document_management.share_require_code_hint: Liphasiwedi lihamba nge-imeyili lefanako nesixhumanisi. Likhodi leliphelelwe kulelo likheli likhombisa kutsi lovulako unelibhokisi lemeyili.
document_management.share_require_code_needs_email: Ngeta likheli le-imeyili lememukeli kute usebentise loku.
document_management.shared_code_hint: Singatfumela likhodi ku-{email} kucinisekisa kutsi nguwe.
document_management.shared_code_sent_hint: Likhodi litfunyelwe ku-{email}. Lihlala imizuzu lelishumi nesihlanu.
document_management.quotas_subtitle: Ngaphansi kwaleyo yenkhampani. Umnyango munye logcwalisa yonkhe imvume umisa wonkhe umuntfu, yonkhe indzawo.
document_management.quotas_none: Kute imikhawulo lebekiwe. Kusebenta kuphela imvume yenkhampani.
document_management.quotas_warn_hint: Kwaliwa ngaphandle kwesecwayiso kufana nemshini lowephukile.
document_management.access_map_refusals_hint: Kwaliwa kunye sixhumanisi lesidzala. Lokuyimfica ngeliviki yingcoco.
document_management.access_map_downloads_hint: Kulayisha sikhatsi lapho umculu ungasalawulwa ngulomshini.
document_management.access_map_heavily_granted_hint: Nome bayakudzinga, nome kubutsene ngasinye ngesikhatsi. Linombolo kuphela kwendlela yekwati.
document_management.shortcuts_hint: Indzawo yesibili yekutfola lomculu — hhayi likhophi lesibili.
document_management.shortcuts_dialog_hint: Uhlala ungumculu munye. Inguculo lensha ivela yonkhe indzawo lapho ugcinwe khona, futsi timvume tawo atitjintji.
document_management.access_ask_hint: Khetsa konkhe lokudzingako ngasikhatsi sinye. Kucela ngakunye kulapho lokwekugcina kukhohlakala khona.
document_management.access_ask_reason_hint: Lophendvulako kufanele ancume lokutsite, futsi "kute sizatfu lesiniketiwe" kucishe kube kwala.
document_management.checklists_people_hint: Khetsa munye nome labanyenti — kucalwa liphakethe kumuntfu ngamunye.
document_management.perm_manage_explainer: Somebody who administers a folder decides who else may use it. They cannot move it, delete it, or reach any other folder.
document_management.folder_permissions_subtitle: A group survives somebody joining or leaving. A list of names has to be revisited every time either happens.
document_management.folder_permissions_none: Nobody has been given this folder. Whether it is open depends on the folder's own kind.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_body: This replaces every rule on {name} with what is on screen.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_consequence: Anybody whose row you removed loses access as soon as this is saved.
document_management.groups_delete_consequence: Everyone in it loses every folder the group opened. The folders and their documents are untouched.
document_management.groups_remove_member_title: Take this person out of the group?
document_management.groups_remove_member_consequence: They lose every folder this group opens, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_title: Take this folder off the group?
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_consequence: Everyone in the group loses it, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.documents_delete_consequence: It goes to the recycle bin and can be restored until the bin is emptied.
document_management.templates_delete_consequence: Documents already generated from it are not affected.
document_management.quotas_remove_consequence: Storage there becomes unlimited again, up to the company's own allowance.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_body: {who} would no longer see this document.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_consequence: Unless they can reach it another way — through a folder, a role or a group.

Ayenti futsi ayincomi imiphumela yekucasha, kuxosha nome yeludvuma. Kufana kweligama akusiwo bufakazi bebunini. Sebentisa kuphela ngemvume nangekuhambisana nemtsetfo wemfihlo newetisebenti.

employee_reputation_settings.compliance_body: Vula kubukwa kuphela lapho uvunyelwe khona nalapho kuhambisana nemtsetfo wemfihlo newetisebenti. Kubukwa lwati LEMPHAKATSI kuphela — hhayi ema-akhawunti langasese. Lokutfoliwe kuyachazeka, kunemaphuzu ekwetsembeka nemsuka, kuhlonipha sikhatsi sekugcina lesingentansi, kulawulwa ngekufinyelela futsi kuhlolwa ngalokugcwele, futsi akusetjentiselwa tincumo temsebenti letitentekelako.

Kufana kweligama akusiwo bufakazi bebunini. Buketa bufakazi ngekwakho bese unika lofakisicelo litfuba lekuniketa umongo ngaphambi kwekwenta tincumo.

dashboard.step_work_centres_hint: Sikhungo lesingenalo linani angeke sihlelwe noma sibalelwe tindleko
dashboard.step_units_hint: Kuyadzingeka ngaphambi kwekutsi noma nguyiphi indlela yekupheka isho bunyenti
dashboard.step_products_hint: Imikhicito lephelele, lephakatsi kanye netincenye letihlanganisiwe
dashboard.step_boms_hint: Umkhicito longenayo indlela yekupheka legunyatiwe angeke uodwe
dashboard.no_shutdowns: Kute kuvalwa lokuhleliwe noma lokwentekako nyalo.
dashboard.no_bom_hint: I-oda lekukhicita angeke lifakelwe loku kuze kugunyatwe luhlu lwetinsita.

products.title: Imikhicito
products.subtitle: Inchazelo yebunjiniyela yako konkhe lokukhicitako, lokutsengako nalokusebentisako
products.add_hint: Umkhicito wandzisa intfo yesitoko lekhona. Ikhodi, ligama netindleko kuhlala entfweni yesitoko.
products.name: Ligama
products.none_hint: Ngeta intfo yesitoko erejistini yebunjiniyela kute ucale.

product.bought_no_recipe: Lena yintfo letsengiwe, ngako ayinayo indlela yekupheka.
product.no_recipes: Kute indlela yekupheka lesebhalwe njengeluhlaka yalomkhicito okwanyalo.
product.external_reference_hint: Inombolo yemdvwebo yelikhasimende, yemdvwebo logcinwe kulenye indzawo
product.no_documents: Kute imidvwebo, imiyalo noma kucaciswa lokubhaliwe.
product.register_hint: Kutsi lifayela ngalinye lelani. Khomba lokufakiwe efayeleni lelifakwe ngenhla, noma kunkhomba legcinwe kulenye indzawo.
product.no_attributes: Kute tici. Ngeta nobe nguyiphi inchazelo lefekthri yakho leyisebentisako — kucedzela, bulukhuni, sikhala semuchinga.

boms.title: Tinhlu Tetinsita
boms.subtitle: Tindlela tekupheka, tinguculo kanye nekugunyata
boms.new_hint: Ngulemikhicito lephelele, lephakatsi kanye netincenye letihlanganisiwe kuphela letingaba nendlela yekupheka. Insita lengakacutjungulwa iyatsengwa, ayentiwa.
boms.none_hint: Bhala luhlaka lwendlela yekupheka kusuka emkhicitweni kute ucale.

bom.name: Ligama
bom.batch_size_hint: Kulahlekelwa ngesikhatsi sekucubungula nekusetha kukhokhwa kanye ngeqoqo ngalinye
bom.alternate_group_hint: Imigca lehlanganyela licembu ingukukhetsa kunye, hhayi tidzingo letinyenti
bom.discard_body: Lolu luhlaka netincenye talo kutawususwa. Tinguculo letigunyatiwe atikaze titsintseke.
bom.locked_approved: Lenguculo igunyatiwe futsi angeke ihlelwe. Ibuyeketa kute ushintje indlela yekupheka — yekucala ihlala injalo ncamashi, futsi ema-oda lasakhululiwe achubeka ayisebentisa.
bom.locked_superseded: Lenguculo itsatfelwe sikhundla futsi igcinwe njengelirekhodi. Itsatfelwe sikhundla ngu
bom.locked_obsolete: Lenguculo iyekisiwe futsi angeke isetjentiswe kunoma nguliphi i-oda lelisha.

where_used.title: Lapho Kusetjentiswa Khona
where_used.subtitle: Ngutiphi tindlela tekupheka insita levela kuto — buta ngaphambi kwekutsi uyishintje noma uyiyekise
where_used.choose: Khetsa insita kute ubone tonkhe tindlela tekupheka letiyisebentisako.
where_used.none: Lensita ayisetjentiswa kunoma nguyiphi indlela yekupheka lesebentako.

factories.title: Tifekthri
factories.subtitle: Tindzawo, iminyango kanye nemigca yekukhicita
factories.concepts: Ifekthri, inqolobane, umugca wekukhicita kanye nesikhungo semsebenti tintfo letehlukene. Ifekthri inekhalenda nemali; inqolobane igcina sitoko; umugca yindlela lehamba efekthri; sikhungo semsebenti sinemandla netindleko ngelihora.
factories.none_hint: Yakha indzawo yakho yekucala kute ucale kuhlela tikhungo temsebenti nemashifu.
factories.warehouse_hint: Lapho sitoko salefekthri sifika khona. Tinqolobane tiphatfwa kuTimali.
factories.assign_hint: Umuntfu lonikwe ifekthri uvalelwa kuyo. Angeke abone kuhlelwa, tikhungo temsebenti noma emashifu enye ifekthri ngaphandle kwekutsi naye unikwe khona.
factories.whole_factory_hint: Shiya kungenalutfo kute umnike yonkhe ifekthri, noma ukhetse umnyango munye kute umvalele etikhungweni temsebenti tawo.
factories.unrestricted: Kute lonikwe lapha, ngako wonkhe lonemvumo yalemojuli angayibona lefekthri. Nika bantfu kute ubavalele etifekthrini labatiphatsako.
factories.all_factories_note: Indzima yakho iyabona tonkhe tifekthri, ngako loku kunikwa akushintji loko lokubonako.

setup.remove_factory_deactivates: {name} inetikhungo temsebenti letinemlandvo wekukhicita, ngako itawuvalwa kunekutsi isuswe.

workcentres.title: Tikhungo Temsebenti
workcentres.subtitle: Emandla, emanani etindleko, tindzawo tekusebentela kanye nemishini
workcentres.none_hint: Yakha ifekthri kucala, bese ungeta tindzawo lapho imisebenti yentiwa khona.
workcentres.unrated: Tikhungo temsebenti letingu-{n} atinawo emandla noma linani letindleko, ngako angeke tihlelwe noma tibalelwe tindleko.
workcentres.machine_hint: Imishini ivela erejistini yetimphahla, ngako tinombolo te-serial nemlandvo wekulungisa kuhlala endzaweni yinye.

shifts.title: Emashifu Nekuvalwa
shifts.subtitle: Tindlela tekusebenta, imitsetfo yesikhatsi lesengetiwe kanye nekumiswa lokuhleliwe
shifts.overnight_hint: Lelishifu liphela ngaphambi kwekutsi licale. Nangabe lisebenta ebusuku, vula "Kuphela ngelilanga lelilandzelako".
shifts.line_hint: Shiya kungenalutfo nangabe yonkhe ifekthri iyama
shifts.calendar_hint: Loko lefekthri lengakusebenta ngempela lilanga ngalinye: emashifu, kususwe emaholide emphakatsi, kususwe kuvalwa.
shifts.calendar_none: Yakha ifekthri nelishifu kute ubone ikhalenda yayo yekusebenta.

units.title: Emayunithi Ekulinganisa
units.subtitle: Emayunithi, tilinganiso kanye netiguculo letivumelekile
units.rule: Emayunithi aguculeka kalula ngekhatsi kwesilinganiso sinye (kg kuya ku-g). Emkhatsini wetilinganiso akwenteki — emakhilogremu kuya kumalitha kuya ngensita, futsi liphekhi lincike entfweni — ngako loko kubhalwa ngentfo ngayinye ngentasi.
units.conversions_hint: Buhlobo lobungaguculeki bentfo yinye — liphekhi lelinetintfo letilishumi nambili, ligubhu lemalitha langu-210
units.container_hint: Titsitsi atinabo bukhulu bato. Kutsi mangaki emayunithi lasephekhini kuncike entfweni, ngako kubhalwa ngentfo ngayinye ngentasi.

numbering.title: Kunombola Emadokhumente
numbering.subtitle: Kulandzelana kwetinombolo te-oda lekukhicita, temsebenti netemadokhumente
numbering.scope_hint: Shiya kungenalutfo kute kube kulandzelana kwenkhampani yonkhe
numbering.none_hint: Faka emayunithi lajwayelekile nekulandzelana kusuka ekhasini leMayunithi.

policies.title: Tinchubomgomo Nekugunyata
policies.subtitle: Imikhawulo levumelekile, imitsetfo yekukhicita kanye nemikhawulo yekugunyata
policies.blank_hint: Shiya umkhawulo kungenalutfo kusho "kute lokuhleliwe". Loko kwehlukile ku-0%, lokusho kutsi wonkhe umehluko kufanele uchazwe.
policies.require_bom_approval: Tinhlu tetinsita tidzinga kugunyatwa ngumuntfu lohlukile kulowalubhala
policies.require_qc: Dzinga kuhlola likhwalithi ngaphambi kwekubeka esitolo
policies.allow_negative: Vumela sitoko kutsi sehle ngaphansi kwalutfo
policies.allow_over_issue: Vumela kukhipha lokunyenti kunaloko i-oda lelikudzingako
policies.limits_hint: Ema-oda ekukhicita langetulu kwalinani lutsite adzinga umgunyati lomkhulu. Libhande ngalinye limboza emanani ema-oda latsite; ndzawonye kufanele amboze onkhe emanani.
policies.limits_applies: Kuhlolwa nangabe i-oda lekukhicita ligunyatwa, kusetjentiswa linani le-oda lelilinganiselwako.
policies.approver_hint: Ngulabo labaphetse lemvumo kuphela labangagunyata ema-oda kulelibhande
policies.no_holders: Kute loyiphetse okwanyalo — ema-oda kulelibhande abengeke agunyatwe
policies.factory_hint: Emabhande efekthri asetjentiswa ngaphambi kwalawo enkhampani yonkhe
policies.escalate_hint: Khumbuta umphatsi wemgunyati nangabe kulindza sikhatsi lesingaka
policies.summary: Ema-oda ekukhicita lanenani {from} {to} {where} adzinga kugunyatwa ngumuntfu longakhona “{who}”.

categories.title: Tigaba temikhicito
categories.hint: Luhlu lapho kukhetfwa khona tigaba. Sigaba lesisetjentiswako siyekiswa kunekutsi sisuswe, ngako imikhicito lefakwe ngaphansi kwaso iyasigcina.
categories.name: Sigaba lesisha
categories.none_yet: Kute tigaba okwanyalo. Ngeta sinye kute ucale.

routings.title: Tindlela Tekukhicita
routings.subtitle: Indlela umkhicito ngamunye lohamba ngayo efekthri: imisebenti, tikhungo temsebenti, tikhatsi kanye nemasango
routings.none_hint: Bhala luhlaka lwendlela yekukhicita yemkhicito kute ucale.

routing.operations_hint: Ngekulandzelana. Umsebenti angeke ucedvwe kuze kube ngulemisebenti lephocelelekile ngaphambi kwawo, nemasango ayo, seyiphumelele.
routing.alt_run_hint: Shiya kungenalutfo kute usebentise sikhatsi sekusebenta semsebenti ngekwawo
routing.machine_type_hint: Esikhundleni sesikhungo semsebenti: noma nguyiphi sikhungo lesinalolu luhlobo lwemshini
routing.parallel_hint: Imisebenti lenelicembu lelifanako isebenta ngesikhatsi sinye
routing.locked_approved: Lendlela yekukhicita igunyatiwe futsi angeke ihlelwe. Ibuyeketa kute ushintje indlela umkhicito lowentiwa ngayo — ema-oda lasakhululiwe achubeka asebentisa lenguculo.
routing.discard_body: Lolu luhlaka lwendlela yekukhicita nemisebenti yalo kutawususwa. Tinguculo letigunyatiwe atikaze titsintseke.
routing.estimate_hint: Loko kwenta bunyenti lobutsite lokukudzingako, kubalwe ngekhalenda yefekthri.

orders.title: Ema-oda ekukhicita
orders.subtitle: Onkhe ema-oda, kusuka eluhlakeni kuze kuvalwe
orders.new_hint: Kubotjelwe ku-BOM nendlela yekukhicita lesebentako ngelusuku lwekucala
orders.none_hint: Faka linye kusuka emkhicitweni lonaluhlu lwetinsita olugunyatiwe.
orders.start_hint: Kuncuma kutsi ngutiphi tinguculo te-BOM netendlela yekukhicita i-oda letisebentisako
orders.material_warehouse_hint: Lapho tinsita tikhishwa khona; inqolobane yalokukhicitiwe nangabe kungenalutfo
orders.allow_below_min_batch: Vumela bunyenti lobungaphansi kweqoqo lelincane lendlela yekukhicita
orders.locked_closed: Leli-oda livaliwe. Emarekhodi alo akhiyiwe; kulungiswa kwentiwa ngekulungisa emanani.
orders.checks_hint: Loko kugunyata lokukucinisekisako, njengoba kunjalo nyalo
orders.checks_clear: Tinsita, i-BOM, indlela yekukhicita nemandla konkhe kuhlelekile.
orders.receive_output_hint: Esitokweni ngetindleko letijwayelekile tetinsita; ekuhlukaniseni nangabe ifekthri ihlola ngaphambi kwekubeka esitolo
orders.output_hint: Lokukhicitiwe nekulahlekelwa kubhalwa ngulabasefekthri ngesikhatsi i-oda lisachubeka.
orders.approve_override_hint: Tinsita tiyashoda noma emandla esetsembiswe ngalokwengca. Kugunyata noko kubhalwa njengekuhluka kanye nesizatfu sakho.
orders.rescale_hint: Bunyenti lobusha bulinganisa kabusha tinsita, imisebenti kanye nekulinganisela
orders.lot_hint: Shiya kungenalutfo kute kukhetfwe lokuphelelwa sikhatsi kucala
orders.over_issue: Loku kunyenti kunaloko i-oda lelisakudzingako. Kukhipha ngalokwengca kudzinga kweca lokugunyatiwe nesizatfu ngaphandle kwekutsi ifekthri iyakuvumela.
orders.lot_number_hint: Kuba yinombolo ye-oda ({n}) ngekujwayelekile kumkhicito lolandzelelwa ngeqoqo
orders.quality_hold: Kukhicita kumisiwe kuze likhwalithi lincume nge-{list}.

quality.inspections_subtitle: Konkhe kuhlola lokusafanele kubhalwe noma kunqunywe, nalokusevele kuvaliwe
quality.hold_hint: Kumisa sitoko lesisetjentiswako; kute lokungasikhipha noma sitfunyelwe kuze kube kunesincumo

disposition_hint.CONDITIONAL_ACCEPT: Kusisebentisa noma kunalokutfoliwe. Kubhalwa njengekuvumelana kanye nesizatfu sakho.
disposition_hint.REJECT: Kuhambisa sitoko lesimisiwe kulokwaliwe; angeke size sikhishwe noma sitfunyelwe.
disposition_hint.RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER: Kwala sitoko ngekuya kumhlinzeki ne-oda lakhe lekutsenga.

quality.held_alert: {qty} simiswe ku-{status} kuze kube kunesincumo ngalokuhlola.
quality.blocking_alert: Loku kuhlola lokwehlulekile kumisa kukhicita ku-oda lako kuze umuntfu lonemvumo ancume kutsi kwentekani ngemsebenti.
quality.record_hint_plan: Kuhlola ngakunye kwahlulelwa ngekwemikhawulo yako ngekutentakalela. Tisampula letingu-{n} ngekuhlola ngakunye.
quality.record_hint_adhoc: Kute luhlelo lolusebentako, ngako bita kuhlola ngakunye bese uyakwahlulela.
quality.decide_hint: Sincumo kuphela lesihambisa sitoko noma lesivumela kukhicita kuchubeke.
quality.certificate_required: Lolu luhlelo idzinga sitifikethi lesifakwe ngentasi ngaphambi kwekutsi sitoko sikhululwe.
quality.plans_subtitle: Lokuhlolwako, ngumiphi imikhawulo, kanye naloko kwehluleka lokukumisako
quality.checks_hint: Silinganiso lesinemikhawulo, noma sici sekuphumelela/kwehluleka. Kuhlola kugcina likhophi lemikhawulo lokwabhalwa ngayo.
quality.sample_size_hint: Kutsi mingaki imiphumela lekudzingwa kuhlola ngakunye
quality.operation_hint: Kungenalutfo: noma nguyiphi indzawo yekuhlola yalomkhicito
quality.critical_hint: Kubalulekile kakhulu: kwehluleka lapha kuveta lokungahambisani nemtsetfo lokukhulu
quality.ncrs_subtitle: Lokuhambe kabi, kungani, nekutsi yini lekuvimbela kutsi kuphindze kwenteke
quality.search_ncrs: Sesha inombolo, ikhodi yeliphutsa noma umbhalo
quality.repeat_defects_hint: Tikhodi temaphutsa letifakwe kwendlula kanye emnyakeni lowendlule
quality.due_hint: Kungenalutfo: emalanga la-3, la-7 noma la-21 ngekuya ngebucotfo
quality.not_effective: Kucinisekisa kwekugcina kutfole kutsi sento asisebenti. {notes}
quality.investigation_hint: Kulawule, tfola imbangela lesisekelo, bese wenta ngayo
quality.actions_hint: Kulawula, kulungisa nekuvikela, ngamunye anemnikati nelusuku lwekugcina
quality.repeats_hint: Ikhodi yeliphutsa lelifanako kulensita noma kulomhlinzeki emnyakeni lowendlule
quality.no_code: Nika i-NCR ikhodi yeliphutsa kute kubalwe kuphindvwa.
quality.verify_hint: I-NCR lenkhulu noma lebaluleke kakhulu icinisekiswa ngumuntfu longakenti nasinye setento tayo.

floor.title: Umsebenti wasefekthri
floor.scan: Skena likhadi lemsebenti, i-oda noma iqoqo
floor.offline: Akukho ku-inthanethi: kuchafata kuyagcinwa bese kutfunyelwa ngemuva
floor.pause_hint: Nika sizatfu nangabe umsebenti wema ngobe kukhona lokuhambe kabi; kubhalwa njengesikhatsi lokungasetjentwa ngaso.
floor.time_measured: Sikhatsi semshini nesebasebenti sitsatfwa esikhatsini lomsebenti lowasebenta ngaso.
floor.queued: Kute kuchumana: kugciniwe, kutawutfunyelwa nangabe inethiwekhi ibuyile.
floor.downtime_subtitle: Konkhe kumiswa, ngesikhungo semsebenti nangesizatfu, kanye nekutsi kubite imizuzu lemingakhi
